; pinnedPageSleepScreen v0.44.2
; REQUIRES the fastshot xovi extension (extensions/fastshot >= 0.11.0 for
; fastLuma's edge-relative rects (negative x/y = from the far edge) — the
; dynamic verdict samples the band in PHYSICAL image coordinates BEFORE the
; window is sized (an older build clamps a negative offset to 0, so the
; bottom/right bands sample the wrong edge on rotated/inverted content);
; >= 0.10.0 for the row step and luma:chroma cells — a 0.9.0 build answers
; luma-only cells (chroma reads 0, the light-tint test degrades to
; brightness-only) and an older build ignores the grid line and answers the
; single mean, so the dynamic vote degrades to the average; >= 0.8.0 for
; fastAbortShots, which cancels a queued chapter shot that would otherwise fire
; after sleep entry and capture our own sleep window over the fresh grab — an
; older build simply loses that cancellation; >= 0.7.0 for fastStat, the chapter
; freshness gate — with an older build every chapter reads as unavailable
; and the pinned path degrades to stock): freeze captures are
; synchronous BMPs on tmpfs (~70ms end-to-end vs rm-shot's ~600ms PNG); rm-shot is
; still used for the persistent pinned/chapter PNGs.
; Pin a specific document page as the sleep screen shown by the sleep window — and,
; via the native "Visible content" toggle, keep the CURRENT screen on the sleep screen:
; the Navigator snapshots the framebuffer at the instant a sleep begins (its state-change
; handler runs before the sleep window renders), and freeze mode displays that shot.
; (A transparent sleep window does NOT retain: the app UI beneath is torn down at deep
; entry, leaving plain white — verified on device.)
;
; Button sleep is a SINGLE committed 0->2 entry: the sleep window renders in EPD Sleep
; mode, which full-refreshes regardless of content — pixel identity buys nothing, and a
; bounce+re-sleep pipeline just doubles the storms (v0.17.x post-mortem, removed). The
; sleep window is RECREATED on every entry with default property values, so the newborn
; window paints a white placeholder until its first decide() lands (pinSleepDecided),
; then the freeze shot appears within the entry's own refresh storm. The button-entry
; capture includes chrome (accepted for now; the 0->1 idle capture is chrome-less
; because the native inSuspend repaint hides chrome before the grab — the sleep
; surface owns the fb <150ms after 0->2, so no delayed shot can do better).
;
; White-phase minimization (v0.18.2): the QML Image decodes when source is SET, not
; when the EPD flushes — if the decode completes inside the entry's ~1s refresh storm,
; the first flush already shows the capture. Decode retries and the power.json recheck
; run at 250-300ms. The write stays ASYNC: a synchronous XHR PUT spins a nested event
; loop, letting the newborn window's decide() read the file MID-WRITE (v0.18.1
; regression: truncated JSON parsed as "no freeze" -> carousel). decide() is fail-safe
; instead: an unreadable record leaves the window undecided (white) and the recheck
; re-reads; only a successfully parsed record commits gate values.
;
; Sleep-screen matrix (pinned x Settings.lightSleepEnabled), per-sleep entry origin
; (button = displayState 0->2, idle = 1->2, recorded to power.json by the Navigator):
;   unpinned + off : stock wallpaper everywhere
;   unpinned + on  : current screen everywhere (freeze)
;   pinned   + off : pinned page everywhere
;   pinned   + on  : button -> pinned page, idle -> current screen (asymmetric)
;
; Bar style (v0.36, Settings > Display > "Sleep screen style"):
; Values.pinSleepBarStyle is "white" (v0.35 rendering: white strip, black glyphs),
; "black" (inverted) or "translucent". Every style binding in both bars tests
; `=== "black"` and never `=== "white"`: an unknown value read back from QSettings
; must degrade to the white bar, and testing for "white" would hand it the black
; arm. Only the WHITE strip draws the seam border and the contacts strip inverts
; with the style (owner rulings 2026-08-19, v0.42): there is no natural black
; page, so a border on the black strip is either invisible or decoration.
; Battery icon (v0.42.1, owner-chosen route): the stock widget's one public
; color knob (`highlighted`, set by stock MinimalBatteryIndicator) is a
; low-battery emphasis that floods the body with the border color — on the
; black strip body/notch/outline would vanish leaving bare floating segments.
; Instead the black arm hands the widget an INVERTED TOKEN CLONE: the compiled
; wrapper forwards `type` and accepts a plain JS object (device probe
; 2026-08-20, src/probeBatteryTokens.qmd — wrapper.type assignable=true;
; metrics: border 2, hPad 4, vPad 3, spacing 4, segment 4x12, notch 2x8), so
; the bar deep-copies the LIVE ArkTokens.BatteryIndicator.primary and flips
; every color — stock geometry in white, tracking whatever metrics the OS
; ships. `type` is private in ark's source; if an OTA reshapes it the clone
; throws and the arm falls back to `highlighted` (degraded but readable).
; v0.44 retires the mod-drawn segmented twin outright: the stock widget is the
; ONLY battery icon on the bar, and the clone drives its polarity everywhere
; (black style always, dynamic on the battery run's own vote). It carries no
; halo — accepted (owner ruling 2026-08-20): the strokes are thick and the
; polarity flip alone is judged enough; revisit only if testing shows it lost.
;
; Translucent = DYNAMIC (v0.44, deep-sleep bar ONLY; owner rulings 2026-08-20
; after the v0.43 translucent smoke test; verdict machinery rebuilt in v0.44.1
; after the white-flash regression, see below). The tier-3 radio (full/
; outline/cascading) and the island pills are retired — the half-transparent
; plates looked bad over pictures, and the style now always decides FROM the
; picture. Two outcomes:
;   1. FULL WHITE BAR — when the band under the bar is essentially white. A
;      mostly-white document absorbs an opaque white bar seamlessly, so the
;      seam border is dropped too (a border there is the one thing that would
;      give it away). Judged on a 24x2 cell grid of the whole band sampled
;      every 8th row (fastLuma >=0.10.0), NOT one average — a dark corner can
;      hide inside a good mean (the 2026-08-20 test image averaged 219 while
;      cells read 66). A cell must be bright (>=200) AND unsaturated (chroma
;      <=24): luma alone called a uniform LIGHT BLUE (~205) white — chroma
;      (max-min channel) is ~0 for white/grey and ~50 for any tint. Cells
;      under the FIXED text fractions (left/center/right generous supersets
;      of the date/clock/battery layout at both orientations) count as white:
;      the render covers them, so strokes under the glyphs must not veto.
;   2. OUTLINED GLYPHS on the bare picture — ONE bar-wide polarity (v0.44.1
;      owner ruling: v0.44's per-run votes split on mid-tone images — diamond
;      black, battery white — and consistency beats local luma accuracy; the
;      halo is the legibility guarantee wherever the shared verdict is
;      locally wrong). Majority of cells dark (<128) by AREA -> white ink,
;      else black. The halo is 8 same-size copies of the string in a ring
;      under the core (a true dilation that keeps kerning; scaled copies
;      distort and miss inner corners), ring offset 3u, and its color is
;      always the INK'S OPPOSITE — white ink gets a black halo.
; The verdict is LATCHED, not a live binding (v0.44.1): applyPower computes it
; once per record, in the same call that settles decided/freeze/orient/path,
; from FIXED band fractions — so the treatment is chosen for the frame the EPD
; actually latches and nothing it reads can move afterwards. v0.44's binding
; also read the runs' live x/width (which settle after the first frame) and
; defaulted the undecided bar to WHITE: the post-paint white->transparent flip
; forced a second full-screen EPD refresh — the ~1s white flash the owner
; caught (the capture itself never regressed; grab-to-window stayed ~80ms).
; Undecided/unreadable/carousel now render a TRANSPARENT bar with black ink in
; a white halo — outlined type reads on any background, and painting nothing
; until the verdict exists means the white bar can never appear then retract.
; The latch also breaks the battery feedback edge for real (the token clone
; could plausibly move the stock widget's implicitWidth -> Row width -> the
; v0.44 sampled rect): no geometry a verdict can influence is ever sampled.
; The light-sleep banner deliberately does NOT mirror any of this (see there).
;
; Sleep-entry chapter (v0.40): a stroke written seconds before sleep missed the
; book — the pen-lift capture is debounced and its shot delayed, so a quick sleep
; showed a stale page. The DeviceSceneView power handler now takes ONE synchronous
; fastShot at 0->!0 and saves the book inline, after aborting every in-flight async
; shot (a late one grabs the sleep window itself and its fixed chN path would
; overwrite the fresh capture). Recorded as a NORMAL chapter with its real
; chromeNow() rects — the layering then patches the toolbar band from an older
; clean chapter, which is the "current screen plus patching" merge for free.
; Two v0.41 corrections, both journal-proven on device 2026-08-19: (1) the
; native suspend path hides chrome in the QML TREE before this handler runs —
; on BOTH entry origins, not just idle — while the fb still shows it, so the
; entry-time tree query answered [] and the chrome-full grab superseded every
; clean chapter as ch0. The watch keeps a last-known awake-time chrome snapshot
; (refreshed by every captureNow, by toolbar shown/expanded edges and by hold
; release) and the entry substitutes the snapshot rects when the tree goes
; quiet. (2) the chapter ts is stamped BEFORE the grab: the v0.39 freshness
; gate drops any chapter whose file mtime is older than its ts, and stamping
; after a synchronous grab left mtime a few ms short — every sleep-entry
; chapter read as stale. Book superseded by (1), chapters dropped by (2):
; pinned collapsed to the freeze fallback (or the stock carousel with light
; sleep off), which is what made the v0.40 smoke test look like a pass.
;
; Toolbar button (v0.37): tap = pin/unpin the page you are on, long-press = sleep
; now showing this very screen. It is a bare ArkControls.ToolButton (the stock
; hideShowButton template), NOT a ToolbarTool: floating.qmd owns a `pressAndHold`
; signal on ToolbarTool.qml and a second declaration would not compile. The pin
; write itself lives ONE place — DocumentView's pinSleepApplyPin() — because that
; root is the only object both callers can reach (the toolbar via its own bus, the
; pages-overview foldout via pageActions.documentView, the pattern its chrome-hold
; already uses); the overview keeps its selection handling, toast and page jump.
; Long-press does NOT pre-write a power record (the Navigator's own write at the
; real transition would clobber it): it sets the one-shot Values.pinSleepForceFreeze
; timestamp and calls BatteryManager.requestSleep() (the verdict-tested API — never
; goToSleep()). The Navigator treats a flag younger than 10s as "Visible content is
; on" for that single transition and marks the record forced, which is the only
; thing that makes a PINNED tablet freeze the current screen on a button entry.
; The flag is deliberately NOT in the Settings block: a crash mid-sleep must not
; leave it armed across a restart.
;
; Requires: rm-shot, framebuffer-spy, xovi-message-broker, qt-resource-rebuilder,
;           qt-command-executor, fastshot (bundled)
; State:    /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json
;             v2: {docId, pageId, pageIdx, ts, orient, chapters:[{file, chrome:[{x,y,w,h}], transform, ts}]}
;             orient (v0.34, additive) is top-level: a rotation moves the page
;             transform, so tfEq drops the whole book — one live orientation
; Images:   /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/ch0.png (chrome-free) .. ch3.png (rotating)
;           + legacy pinned.png (pin-time blind capture; shown only when no chapters)
;
; Toolbar-less display (docs/toolbarless-design.md): every capture records which screen
; rects were covered by chrome ("chapter"); the sleep window stacks chapter images
; oldest->newest, each painted with holes at its own chrome rects, so every pixel shows
; the newest chrome-free content. ch0 is captured with ALL chrome hidden: DocumentView's
; Item#_uiContainer contains the toolbar and every overlay (incl. other mods' floating
; bars), so one replaced binding blanks them all; the hold engages only while chrome is
; not painted yet (pin-flow / cold open / wake), so it never flashes.
;
; All insertions are wrapped in id'd child objects: other mods (linkFromSelection,
; createDocumentFromPages, floating) patch the same roots, so root-level attached
; handlers (Component.onCompleted etc.) would collide and break QML compilation.
; Root-level property/function/signal inserts are fine (floating.qmd does the same).

AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/PagesMoreFoldout.qml
	TRAVERSE FoldoutOverlay#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			signal pinSleepClicked
			property string pinSleepLabel: qsTr("Set as sleep screen")
			property bool pinSleepVisible: true
		}

		TRAVERSE ColumnLayout
			LOCATE AFTER ArkControls.FoldoutItem#addAfterItem
			INSERT {
				ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
					id: pinSleepItem
					objectName: "pinSleepItem"
					visible: root.pinSleepVisible
					Layout.fillWidth: true
					label: root.pinSleepLabel
					// ark's Icon resolves iconSource itself (own SVG loader + colorizer). It
					// opens the value as a QFile: bare path works, "file://" URL does NOT
					// (renders blank). Plain QML Image is the opposite — don't mix them up.
					iconSource: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepScreen.svg"
					onClicked: root.pinSleepClicked()
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Navigator (always alive, even on the home screen): records every display power
; transition + the Visible content toggle into power.json, and — when the toggle
; is on — grabs the framebuffer at the moment a sleep begins. This handler runs
; synchronously on the state change, BEFORE the sleep window renders and flushes,
; so a 0-delay shot captures the screen as the user last saw it. (Retention via a
; transparent sleep window does NOT work for deep sleep: the app UI beneath is
; torn down at entry and the composited frame is plain white — verified on
; device. Only the light-sleep banner benefits from a frozen screen.)
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepPower
				visible: false

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepPowerBroker
				}

				CommandExecutor {
					id: pinSleepPowerCmd
				}

				// content orientation at this instant (Navigator's root has the
				// live Orientation object) — recorded into every power record so
				// the sleep window rotates its bars to match the capture, not
				// whatever the orientation module says at window birth (it gets
				// reset to Portrait right after the window opens)
				function orientNow() {
					try {
						return root.orientation ? (root.orientation.orientation | 0) : 0;
					} catch (e) { return 0; }
				}

				function write(prev, next, captured) {
					// ASYNC on purpose: a synchronous PUT spins a nested event loop and
					// the newborn sleep window can then read the file mid-write
					// (truncated JSON — the v0.18.1 carousel regression)
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json");
					xhr.send(JSON.stringify({
						"prev": prev, "next": next, "ts": Date.now(),
						"lightSleepEnabled": Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true,
						"captured": captured === true,
						"orient": pinSleepPower.orientNow()
					}));
				}

				// The passcode handler lives on MainView's root, which is not in
				// this document's scope and whose "root" id our own root shadows —
				// walk the parent chain instead (undefined-property reads on the
				// intermediate QQuickItems are safe). No passcode support -> false.
				function isLocked() {
					for (var o = root; o; o = o.parent) {
						if (o.passcodeHandler !== undefined && o.passcodeHandler !== null) {
							try { return o.passcodeHandler.userLocked === true; } catch (e) { }
							return false;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}

				Connections {
					target: BatteryManager
					ignoreUnknownSignals: true
					function onDisplayStateChanged(previous, next) {
						// toolbar long-press "sleep now with this screen" (v0.37): the
						// button stamps Values.pinSleepForceFreeze and calls
						// requestSleep(), so the transition we are handling right now IS
						// the one it asked for. Fresh = younger than 10s; anything older
						// is a leftover (the requestSleep never landed) and must not turn
						// an unrelated sleep into a capture. ONE-SHOT: cleared here
						// before any branch returns, so a second sleep needs a second
						// long-press. Values is a singleton (pragma Singleton in
						// /qml/common/Values.qml), which is what makes the cross-document
						// write visible here at all.
						var pinSleepForced = false;
						try {
							var pinSleepFlag = Values.pinSleepForceFreeze;
							pinSleepForced = previous === 0 && next !== 0
								&& pinSleepFlag > 0
								&& (Date.now() - pinSleepFlag) < 10000;
							if (pinSleepFlag > 0) Values.pinSleepForceFreeze = 0;
						} catch (e) { }
						if (previous === 0 && next !== 0) {
							// persist pinned chapters to eMMC in the background window after
							// entry: tmpfs dies with a reboot, this copy is restored at the next
							// xochitl start. mtime-gated — only changed chapters are rewritten.
							//
							// Takes a wakelock: without one the suspend can freeze the copy
							// mid-write. The mv keeps the published file from ever being corrupt,
							// but the update is then silently skipped — and that becomes the
							// common case once the awake window shrinks. Cap invariant:
							// copy < cap < shortest window (2s sits under the ~3s vpdd-0 floor;
							// a cap above the window would make a wedged script abort the
							// suspend). Copy cost measured (W0): 4-chapter worst case ~220ms.
							// TRAP: systemd substitutes ${...} in transient-unit command
							// lines itself (invalid name -> empty string) — no brace
							// expansions in any systemd-run script.
							pinSleepPowerCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
								"echo 'pinsleep.persist 2000000000' > /sys/power/wake_lock 2>/dev/null; "
								+ "mkdir -p /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/persist; "
								+ "rm -f /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/persist/*.part; "
								+ "d=/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/persist; "
								+ "if cd /tmp/pinnedSleep 2>/dev/null; then n=0; "
								+ "for f in ch*.bmp; do [ -e \"$f\" ] || continue; "
								+ "if [ \"$f\" -nt \"$d/$f\" ]; then "
								+ "cp \"$f\" \"$d/$f.part\" && n=1; fi; done; "
								+ "if [ \"$n\" = 1 ]; then sync; "
								+ "for f in ch*.bmp; do [ -e \"$d/$f.part\" ] || continue; "
								+ "mv \"$d/$f.part\" \"$d/$f\"; done; fi; fi; "
								+ "echo pinsleep.persist > /sys/power/wake_unlock 2>/dev/null"]);
						}
						// awake -> any sleep: snapshot the screen the user just left.
						// fastShot is a genuinely synchronous native call (~70ms) that
						// atomically writes BOTH the BMP and the power.json record
						// (\n-separated fields; JSON.stringify never emits raw newlines)
						// — the newborn window's very first read is guaranteed fresh, so
						// the freeze image can ride the entry's own refresh instead of
						// waiting out the recheck cadence. The async XHR write remains
						// for every non-capture transition and as the failure fallback.
						// For idle (0->1) the screen then freezes, so the shot stays
						// representative through the whole light phase and into deep.
						// a forced entry counts as the toggle being on for this one
						// transition (plan WP5): same capture, same record shape, plus
						// "forced" so the sleep window's freeze gate overrides the
						// pinned-page arm. Transience is free — ts ages out in 20s and
						// wake flips p.next.
						if (previous === 0 && next !== 0
								&& (Settings.lightSleepEnabled === true || pinSleepForced)) {
							if (pinSleepPower.isLocked()) {
								// The screen is (or is under) the PIN pad — never let
								// that into the sleep image. Re-publish the existing
								// shot (the last unlocked content) with a fresh record
								// so freeze re-shows it; without one, fall to stock.
								// The record MUST land synchronously (fastWrite) like
								// fastShot's sidecar: the async XHR lost the race with
								// the newborn window's first read, which then latched
								// stock on the EPD for the whole nap (v0.26.1 bug).
								var have = ("" + pinSleepPowerBroker.sendSimpleSignal(
									"fastRead", "/tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp"))
									.indexOf("failed") !== 0;
								// re-showing the PRIOR capture: carry ITS orientation
								// forward (device may be held differently now)
								var lor = 0;
								try {
									var lprev = JSON.parse("" + pinSleepPowerBroker.sendSimpleSignal(
										"fastRead", "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json"));
									if (lprev && lprev.orient !== undefined) lor = lprev.orient | 0;
								} catch (le) { }
								// forced rides along even here: the long-press asked for
								// "this screen", and while locked the last UNLOCKED shot
								// is the closest honest answer (never the PIN pad)
								var lrec = JSON.stringify({
									"prev": previous, "next": next, "ts": Date.now(),
									"lightSleepEnabled": true, "captured": have,
									"forced": pinSleepForced,
									"orient": lor
								});
								var lw = pinSleepPowerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastWrite",
									"/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json\n" + lrec);
								if (("" + lw) !== "ok") // old fastshot.so: async fallback
									pinSleepPower.write(previous, next, have);
								return;
							}
							var rec = JSON.stringify({
								"prev": previous, "next": next, "ts": Date.now(),
								"lightSleepEnabled": true, "captured": true,
								"forced": pinSleepForced,
								"orient": pinSleepPower.orientNow()
							});
							var r = pinSleepPowerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastShot",
								"/tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp"
								+ "\n/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json"
								+ "\n" + rec);
							if (("" + r).indexOf("ok:") === 0)
								return; // record already on disk, atomically
						}
						if (previous !== 0 && next === 0) {
							// user is back: undo the sleep-mode power tweaks. Covers
							// waking DURING an RTC window, where no suspend-exit hook
							// ran — WiFi module still unloaded, vpdd hold still short.
							// systemd-run: executeCommand is synchronous and modprobe
							// takes ~1s (too long for a signal handler); a transient
							// unit detaches instantly, survives xochitl, and its run
							// is visible in the journal (a backgrounded subshell was
							// silent and undiagnosable).
							pinSleepPowerCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
								"rm -f /run/pinsleep-wifi-off; "
								+ "lsmod | grep -q iw61x_sdw61x || modprobe iw61x_sdw61x; "
								+ "echo 30000 > /sys/bus/i2c/drivers/g2194-regulator/0-0048/vpdd_length"]);
						}
						pinSleepPower.write(previous, next, false);
					}
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					pinSleepPower.write(-1, BatteryManager.displayState);
					// /etc is a volatile overlay: the timer's enable symlink AND the
					// cadence drop-in die on reboot — re-assert both from the
					// persisted setting (Display > Sleep clock) on every xochitl
					// start. 0 = Never. Harmless no-op when the sleep-clock
					// companion (and thus the unit) is absent.
					var pinSleepMins = Values.pinSleepClockCadence;
					if (pinSleepMins > 0) {
						pinSleepPowerCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							"if [ -e /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer ]; then "
							+ "mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer.d; "
							+ "printf '[Timer]\\nOnCalendar=\\nOnCalendar=*:00/" + pinSleepMins + "\\n'"
							+ " > /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer.d/cadence.conf; "
							+ "systemctl daemon-reload; "
							+ "systemctl enable --now pinsleep-clock.timer; "
							+ "systemctl restart pinsleep-clock.timer; fi"]);
					} else {
						pinSleepPowerCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							"systemctl disable --now pinsleep-clock.timer 2>/dev/null"]);
					}
					// after a reboot, refill tmpfs from the persisted chapter
					// copies — only files that are MISSING (live captures win).
					// cd + relative names: systemd eats brace expansions in
					// transient-unit command lines (see the persist TRAP note).
					// The persist mkdir also creates the STATE DIRECTORY (v0.39):
					// the package installs no state dir, and before this the tree
					// first appeared at the sleep-entry persist job — so a pin
					// taken before the first sleep PUT into a nonexistent
					// directory (Qt routes local-file PUT to QFile, which does not
					// create parents) and the toast still reported success. The
					// persist path implies its parent, and the writers now use
					// fastWrite (mkdirForFile) as well: belt and braces, since
					// fastshot may be absent.
					pinSleepPowerCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
						"mkdir -p /tmp/pinnedSleep /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/persist; "
						+ "if cd /home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/persist 2>/dev/null; then "
						+ "for f in ch*.bmp; do [ -e \"$f\" ] || continue; "
						+ "[ -e \"/tmp/pinnedSleep/$f\" ] || cp \"$f\" \"/tmp/pinnedSleep/$f\"; "
						+ "done; fi"]);
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The toggle's stock description only mentions standby — with this mod it also
; controls the sleep screen, so say so.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/settings/qml/DisplayVisibleContent.qml
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		REPLACE description WITH {
			description: qsTr("Show your open document or overview when in standby and on the sleep screen.")
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Toolbar root: the shared "bus" both DocumentView and DeviceSceneView can reach
; (DeviceSceneView has `required property Item toolbar`). Holds the chrome-hide
; switch, the chrome-rect query hook (assigned by DocumentView, which can also see
; other mods' floating bars), and the toolbar's own painted rects — the inner ids
; (strip/handle/close) are only resolvable from inside Toolbar.qml.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
	IMPORT common 1.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			property bool pinSleepChromeHold: false
			property var pinSleepChromeQuery: null
			// bumped by PagesActions after every pin/unpin write; pin state can change
			// with no page/document signal (same-page pin), so the watch listens here
			property int pinSleepKick: 0

			// page identity in toolbar scope, pushed down by DocumentView (the stock
			// currentPageId alias) — Toolbar.qml itself has no document/page handle,
			// and the `document` identifier other toolbar mods reference here does
			// not resolve in this document. Empty means "no document open", which is
			// also the button's visibility gate.
			property string pinSleepPageId: ""
			// the currently pinned page, published by DeviceSceneView's watch (whose
			// re-read is driven by pinSleepKick) and set optimistically by the pin
			// write itself, so the button's state flips with the tap and is corrected
			// by the file a moment later. Page ids are document-unique.
			property string pinSleepPinnedPageId: ""
			signal pinSleepToggleRequested()

			function pinSleepOwnRects() {
				var out = [];
				if (!root.visible) return out;
				var items = root.expanded ? [toolbar, closeButton] : [hideShowButton];
				for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
					var it = items[i];
					if (!it || !it.visible || it.width <= 0 || it.height <= 0) continue;
					var p = it.mapToItem(root, 0, 0);
					out.push({ "x": Math.floor(p.x), "y": Math.floor(p.y),
						"w": Math.ceil(it.width), "h": Math.ceil(it.height) });
				}
				return out;
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE Item#toolbar > GridLayout
			LOCATE BEFORE Repeater[.objectName="secondaryTools"]
			INSERT {
				// Pin/sleep button. A bare ArkControls.ToolButton on the stock
				// hideShowButton template (background/focusPolicy/gestureMargin
				// insets), NOT a ToolbarTool: floating.qmd declares `signal
				// pressAndHold` on ToolbarTool.qml, and a second declaration of it
				// is a duplicate-name compile failure. Tap toggles the pin,
				// long-press sleeps now with this screen.
				ArkControls.ToolButton {
					id: pinSleepButton
					objectName: "pinSleepButton"

					// betterToc's installed count-adjustment protocol scans
					// toolLayout for _isExtensionButton children and subtracts the
					// SHOWN ones from showableToolsCount — both names are its
					// contract, which is why they carry no mod prefix. The local
					// onShownChanged re-runs that same adjustment (betterToc's root
					// handler only fires when the count itself changes, and with
					// betterToc absent nothing runs it at all, so the last stock
					// tool would overflow) — an in-button handler, never a REPLACE
					// of onShowableToolsCountChanged, which betterToc owns.
					property bool _isExtensionButton: true
					property bool shown: root.pinSleepPageId !== ""
						&& root.showableToolsCount > 7
					onShownChanged: {
						var adjust = 0;
						for (var i = 0; i < toolLayout.children.length; i++) {
							var child = toolLayout.children[i];
							if (child._isExtensionButton && child.shown) adjust++;
						}
						toolbarProvider.updateToolbarTools(root.showableToolsCount - adjust);
					}

					visible: root.expanded && pinSleepButton.shown
					focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
					// The template's `background: Item {}` cannot come along: ark's
					// primary_inverted tokens draw the SELECTED state as a black plate
					// with a white glyph (ark/tokens/IconButtonLarge.qml), so an empty
					// background would render "pinned" as a white icon on the white bar
					// — invisible. hideShowButton can afford to drop the plate because
					// it is never selected. Own plate instead, closeButton's precedent
					// in this same file. Its gestureMargin insets are dropped with it:
					// they exist so the FIRST layout child's background reaches back
					// under toolLayout's margin, and on a mid-column button they would
					// push the plate 20px over its neighbour.
					background: Rectangle {
						color: "black"
						visible: pinSleepButton.selected
					}
					// ToolButton -> IconButton -> contentItem: Icon, i.e. ark's own
					// loader: it opens the value as a QFile, so a bare path works and
					// "file://" renders blank (the FoldoutItem above uses the same).
					iconSource: "/home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepScreen.svg"
					// pin state through ark's on-state (ButtonBase.selected) instead
					// of a second asset; the id comparison is fed by pinSleepKick
					selected: root.pinSleepPageId !== ""
						&& root.pinSleepPageId === root.pinSleepPinnedPageId

					property real pinSleepHeldAt: 0

					onClicked: {
						// Qt suppresses clicked after a pressAndHold, but a stamp
						// costs nothing. A latch would NOT be safe: if the
						// suppression holds it never clears and eats the next tap.
						if (Date.now() - pinSleepButton.pinSleepHeldAt < 1000) return;
						root.pinSleepToggleRequested();
					}

					onPressAndHold: {
						pinSleepButton.pinSleepHeldAt = Date.now();
						// sleep now, showing this screen: arm the one-shot flag the
						// Navigator's transition handler reads, then the
						// verdict-tested entry point (goToSleep() is the guarded
						// low-level one — never call it). The PIN guard sits in that
						// handler, the only scope where the passcode state is
						// reachable.
						Values.pinSleepForceFreeze = Date.now();
						BatteryManager.requestSleep();
					}

					// without its own blocker the pen draws straight through the
					// button onto the page
					PenInputBlocker {
						anchors.fill: parent
						enabled: true
						manager: root.penInput.surfaceManager
					}
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; DocumentView: Item#_uiContainer holds ALL chrome (Toolbar, battery/page/title
; labels, notification bar, zoom button, floating.qmd's panels) while sceneView is
; a sibling outside it — one binding blanks every overlay at once. Never touch
; toolbar.visible itself: it carries a 9-clause stock binding.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
		LOCATE BEFORE Item#_uiContainer
		INSERT {
			property alias pinSleepChromeHold: toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold
			property alias pinSleepKick: toolbar.pinSleepKick

			// The one pin/unpin write (v0.37). It lives on DocumentView's root
			// because that is the only object BOTH callers reach: the toolbar
			// button (its handler is right here, in the Toolbar block below) and
			// the pages-overview foldout item (pageActions.documentView — the very
			// hop its chrome-hold already takes). Selection-free: the caller
			// supplies the identity, so the overview keeps its selection handling,
			// its toast and its page jump while the toolbar does neither.
			// Chrome hold on the pin path: engaged for BOTH callers. A new pin
			// drops the chapter book (transform check), and a capture taken with
			// chrome up produces holes and no clean ch0 — so the ~1.2s of hidden
			// chrome (write -> 400ms kick -> 400ms settle -> capture -> release)
			// buys the chrome-free base image. From the overview that window is
			// invisible (the overview already covers chrome); from the toolbar it
			// is one blink of the bar, the same accepted cost as the transform
			// path. DeviceSceneView releases it, 20s cap.
			XoviMessageBroker {
				id: pinSleepDocBroker
			}

			function pinSleepApplyPin(docId, pageId, pageIdx, unpin) {
				if (!unpin && (!docId || !pageId)) return;
				if (!unpin) toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold = true;
				// fastWrite first (v0.39), XHR only when it is unavailable — same
				// preference power.json already ships. The async PUT was
				// fire-and-forget (no readyState handler): a failed write, most
				// visibly into a state directory that did not exist yet, was
				// indistinguishable from a good one, and the button still flipped.
				// fastWrite is synchronous, atomic (.part + rename) and creates
				// parents, so the reply is the truth about the pin. Timing is
				// unchanged: still one write, still right here.
				var pinSleepRec = unpin ? "{}" : JSON.stringify({
					"docId": docId, "pageId": pageId, "pageIdx": pageIdx
				});
				var pinSleepW = pinSleepDocBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastWrite",
					"/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json\n" + pinSleepRec);
				if (("" + pinSleepW) !== "ok") { // old/absent fastshot.so
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.open("PUT", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					xhr.send(pinSleepRec);
				}
				// optimistic: the watch's re-read corrects it 400ms later, but the
				// button must not look unchanged until then
				toolbar.pinSleepPinnedPageId = unpin ? "" : pageId;
				toolbar.pinSleepKick++;
			}

			Item {
				id: pinSleepChrome
				visible: false

				function push(out, item) {
					if (!item || !item.visible || item.width <= 0 || item.height <= 0) return;
					var p = item.mapToItem(root, 0, 0);
					out.push({ "x": Math.floor(p.x), "y": Math.floor(p.y),
						"w": Math.ceil(item.width), "h": Math.ceil(item.height) });
				}

				function query() {
					var out = [];
					try { if (toolbar.visible) out = toolbar.pinSleepOwnRects(); } catch (e) { }
					// floating-toolbar mod panels; the ids only exist while floating.qmd
					// is applied, so probe them instead of referencing them directly
					try { if (typeof floatQuick !== "undefined") pinSleepChrome.push(out, floatQuick); } catch (e) { }
					try { if (typeof layers !== "undefined") pinSleepChrome.push(out, layers); } catch (e) { }
					return out;
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					if (toolbar.pinSleepChromeQuery === null)
						toolbar.pinSleepChromeQuery = pinSleepChrome.query;
				}
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE Item#_uiContainer
			REPLACE visible WITH {
				visible: !Experimental.pdfPrototype.enabled && !toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold
			}

			; the toolbar bus gets the page identity it cannot see itself, and the
			; button's tap comes back here to the write. Same one-line push as the
			; chrome-rect query hook; `document` and root.currentPage* are stock
			; properties of this scope (the Toolbar block already reads both).
			TRAVERSE Toolbar#toolbar
				LOCATE AFTER ALL
				INSERT {
					pinSleepPageId: root.currentPageId
					onPinSleepToggleRequested: {
						var pinSleepUnpin = root.currentPageId !== ""
							&& root.currentPageId === toolbar.pinSleepPinnedPageId;
						root.pinSleepApplyPin(document ? document.id : "",
							root.currentPageId, root.currentPage, pinSleepUnpin);
					}
				}
			END TRAVERSE
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/PagesActions.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE Item#pageActions
		LOCATE BEFORE Connections[.target=document]
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepCtl
				visible: false

				readonly property string imagePath: "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.png"
				readonly property string statePath: "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json"

				property string docId: ""
				property string pageId: ""
				property int pageIdx: -1

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepCtlBroker
				}

				function load() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							pinSleepCtl.docId = j.docId || "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageId = j.pageId || "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
						} catch (e) {
							pinSleepCtl.docId = "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageId = "";
							pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = -1;
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", pinSleepCtl.statePath);
					xhr.send();
				}

				// the write, the chrome hold and the kick all live in DocumentView's
				// pinSleepApplyPin() (v0.37) — the toolbar button is the second caller
				// and cannot reach anything in this document. Guarded the same way the
				// chrome-hold hop always was: documentView is a nullable Item property.
				function apply(docId, pageId, pageIdx, unpin) {
					try {
						pageActions.documentView.pinSleepApplyPin(docId, pageId, pageIdx, unpin);
					} catch (e) { }
				}

				function toggle() {
					if (pageSelection.isEmpty || pageSelection.pages.length !== 1) return;
					var idx = pageSelection.pages[0];
					var pid = "";
					try { pid = document.idForPage(idx); } catch (e) { }
					if (!pid) return;

					var unpin = (document.id === pinSleepCtl.docId && pid === pinSleepCtl.pageId);

					pageSelection.clear();
					internal.moreButtonState = PagesActions.MoreButtonState.Default;

					if (unpin) {
						pinSleepCtl.docId = ""; pinSleepCtl.pageId = ""; pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = -1;
						pinSleepCtl.apply("", "", -1, true);
						notificationQueue.enqueue({
							"text": qsTr("Removed from sleep screen"),
							"style": Notification.Secondary
						});
					} else {
						pinSleepCtl.docId = document.id; pinSleepCtl.pageId = pid; pinSleepCtl.pageIdx = idx;
						pinSleepCtl.apply(document.id, pid, idx, false);
						notificationQueue.enqueue({
							"text": qsTr("Page set as sleep screen"),
							"style": Notification.Secondary
						});
						// jump to the page so the capture shows it, not this menu
						Qt.callLater(function() {
							try {
								pageActions.documentView.openPage(idx, DocumentView.ScrollPosition.Restore);
							} catch (e) {
								pageActions.requestPage.page = idx;
								pageActions.requestPage.trigger();
							}
							pinSleepCtlBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
								pinSleepCtl.imagePath + ",2000");
						});
					}
				}

				Component.onCompleted: pinSleepCtl.load()
			}
		}

		TRAVERSE Component#moreFoldout
			TRAVERSE PagesMoreFoldout
				LOCATE AFTER ALL
				INSERT {
					pinSleepVisible: !pageSelection.isEmpty && pageSelection.pages.length === 1
					pinSleepLabel: (!pageSelection.isEmpty
							&& pageSelection.pages.length === 1
							&& document.id === pinSleepCtl.docId
							&& pageSelection.pages[0] === pinSleepCtl.pageIdx)
						? qsTr("Remove from sleep screen")
						: qsTr("Set as sleep screen")
					onPinSleepClicked: {
						pinSleepCtl.toggle();
					}
				}
			END TRAVERSE
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: pinSleepWatch
				visible: false

				readonly property string dirPath: "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/"
				// chapters are freshness-scoped (stale after reboot anyway) — tmpfs
				// spares the eMMC ~6MB of wear per rotation; only pinned.png persists
				readonly property string capDirPath: "/tmp/pinnedSleep/"

				property string docId: ""
				property string pageId: ""
				property int pageIdx: -1
				property var chapters: []
				property bool pinActive: docId !== ""
					&& root.document
					&& root.document.id === docId
					&& root.document.idForPage(root.page) === pageId

				// hold state lives on the toolbar bus so PagesActions can pre-engage it
				readonly property bool chromeHeld: root.toolbar
					? root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === true : false

				// last-known awake-time chrome (v0.41): at sleep entry the tree query
				// is blind — see sleepEntryCapture. Refreshed by every captureNow
				// and, through the settle timer, by toolbar shown/expanded edges and
				// hold release; never while the display sleeps (the tree is hidden
				// then, which is exactly the lie this exists to survive).
				property var lastChrome: null
				property double lastChromeTs: 0

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepBroker
				}

				// the toolbar button's pin state (v0.37): publish the pinned page id
				// onto the same bus that carries the hold, so the button never reads
				// pinned.json itself. Driven by the existing refresh paths — reload()
				// runs on page/document change and on pinSleepKick — and pageId is the
				// only input, so one changed-handler covers every route in.
				function publishPin() {
					try {
						if (root.toolbar && typeof root.toolbar.pinSleepPinnedPageId === "string")
							root.toolbar.pinSleepPinnedPageId = pinSleepWatch.pageId;
					} catch (e) { }
				}

				onPageIdChanged: pinSleepWatch.publishPin()

				function beginHold() {
					if (root.toolbar && typeof root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === "boolean")
						root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold = true;
				}

				function releaseHold() {
					pinSleepHoldRelease.stop();
					if (root.toolbar && root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold === true)
						root.toolbar.pinSleepChromeHold = false;
					// chrome repaints back after a release; re-snapshot once it has,
					// or a hold-era [] would masquerade as "screen was chrome-free"
					// at the next sleep entry
					pinSleepSnapTimer.restart();
				}

				function reload() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						try {
							var j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
							pinSleepWatch.docId = j.docId || "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = j.pageId || "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
							// same pre-v0.21 PNG-chapter drop as capture()'s validate
							var ch = [];
							if (j.chapters && j.chapters.length)
								for (var ci = 0; ci < j.chapters.length; ci++)
									if (("" + j.chapters[ci].file).indexOf(".bmp") > 0)
										ch.push(j.chapters[ci]);
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = ch;
						} catch (e) {
							pinSleepWatch.docId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = -1;
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = [];
						}
						// hold hygiene once pinActive is current: drop a hold that landed on
						// the wrong page; engage one when the pinned page is entered while
						// chrome hasn't painted yet (cold open / pin-flow) — that is the
						// flash-free window for the clean chapter-0 capture.
						if (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld && !pinSleepWatch.pinActive) {
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
						} else if (pinSleepWatch.pinActive && !pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld
								&& root.toolbar && root.toolbar.visible === false) {
							pinSleepWatch.beginHold();
						}
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// content orientation at capture time (DeviceSceneView's root carries
				// the live Orientation object, same as the Navigator's) — the sleep
				// window rotates its bar to match the captured chapters
				function orientNow() {
					try {
						return root.orientation ? (root.orientation.orientation | 0) : 0;
					} catch (e) { return 0; }
				}

				function save() {
					// orient is TOP-LEVEL, not per-chapter: tfEq drops every chapter
					// whose page transform moved, and a rotation moves it — so at most
					// one orientation is ever live in the book
					var rec = JSON.stringify({
						"docId": pinSleepWatch.docId,
						"pageId": pinSleepWatch.pageId,
						"pageIdx": pinSleepWatch.pageIdx,
						"ts": Date.now(),
						"orient": pinSleepWatch.orientNow(),
						"chapters": pinSleepWatch.chapters
					});
					// fastWrite first (v0.39): the book is read by a newborn sleep
					// window that may open milliseconds later, and the async PUT was
					// both unacknowledged and non-atomic — a reader could catch a
					// half-written file (JSON.parse fails -> pinned path lost) and a
					// failed write looked exactly like a good one. fastWrite is
					// synchronous and .part+rename, so a reader sees the old book or
					// the new one, never a torn one. WHEN this runs is unchanged:
					// still before the capture is queued (deferring it would widen
					// the unpin-resurrection window fixed in v0.16.1).
					// NOTE the broker wants a BARE path, no file:// scheme.
					var w = pinSleepBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastWrite",
						pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json\n" + rec);
					if (("" + w) !== "ok") { // old/absent fastshot.so
						var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
						xhr.open("PUT", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
						xhr.send(rec);
					}
				}

				function tfNow() {
					var r = root.pageBorderRect;
					return { "x": Math.round(r.x), "y": Math.round(r.y),
						"w": Math.round(r.width), "h": Math.round(r.height) };
				}

				function tfEq(a, b) {
					return a && b
						&& Math.abs(a.x - b.x) <= 2 && Math.abs(a.y - b.y) <= 2
						&& Math.abs(a.w - b.w) <= 2 && Math.abs(a.h - b.h) <= 2;
				}

				function chromeNow() {
					if (pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld) return [];
					var t = root.toolbar;
					if (t && t.pinSleepChromeQuery) {
						try { return t.pinSleepChromeQuery(); } catch (e) { }
					}
					return null;
				}

				function snapChrome() {
					if (BatteryManager.displaySleeping) return;
					var r = chromeNow();
					if (r === null) return;
					pinSleepWatch.lastChrome = r;
					pinSleepWatch.lastChromeTs = Date.now();
				}

				// Unpinning happens in the pages overview with NO page/document change,
				// so pinActive can be stale here — and since capture() writes docId back
				// to pinned.json, a stale capture RESURRECTS the pin (and its image
				// becomes whatever was on screen). Re-validate against the file before
				// every shot; if the pin is gone, adopt that and stand down.
				function capture(delayMs) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						var j = null;
						try { j = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText); } catch (e) { }
						if (!j || !j.docId || !j.pageId) {
							pinSleepWatch.docId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageId = "";
							pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = -1;
							pinSleepWatch.chapters = [];
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
							return;
						}
						pinSleepWatch.docId = j.docId;
						pinSleepWatch.pageId = j.pageId;
						pinSleepWatch.pageIdx = (j.pageIdx !== undefined) ? j.pageIdx : -1;
						// drop pre-v0.21 PNG chapters: the ring is BMP-on-tmpfs now and
						// mixing the two would confuse the slot-reuse bookkeeping
						var ch = [];
						if (j.chapters && j.chapters.length)
							for (var ci = 0; ci < j.chapters.length; ci++)
								if (("" + j.chapters[ci].file).indexOf(".bmp") > 0)
									ch.push(j.chapters[ci]);
						pinSleepWatch.chapters = ch;
						if (!pinSleepWatch.pinActive) {
							pinSleepWatch.releaseHold();
							return;
						}
						pinSleepWatch.captureNow(delayMs);
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file://" + pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// One capture = one chapter update: the current chrome rects + page
				// transform decide whether it overwrites the head chapter (same chrome
				// layout: plain stroke update) or starts a new one (layout changed).
				// A transform change (scroll/zoom/other page) invalidates older chapters:
				// their pixels no longer align. An empty rect list means the screen is
				// chrome-free — that capture supersedes everything as the new ch0.
				function captureNow(delayMs) {
					// last gate before the grab: tryCapture already checked, but
					// capture() re-reads pinned.json over async XHR in between, and a
					// lock landing inside that window would otherwise reach the
					// framebuffer. Covers the rects===null path below too.
					if (pinSleepWatch.isLocked()) return;
					var rects = chromeNow();
					if (rects === null) {
						// metadata plumbing unavailable — plain v0.10 behavior
						pinSleepBroker.sendSimpleSignal("takeScreenshot",
							pinSleepWatch.dirPath + "pinned.png," + delayMs);
						return;
					}

					pinSleepWatch.lastChrome = rects;
					pinSleepWatch.lastChromeTs = Date.now();
					var tf = pinSleepWatch.tfNow();
					var kept = [];
					for (var i = 0; i < pinSleepWatch.chapters.length; i++) {
						if (pinSleepWatch.tfEq(pinSleepWatch.chapters[i].transform, tf))

								&& JSON.stringify(head.chrome) === JSON.stringify(rects)) {

							file = head.file;

					// for nothing. Read-only: the Navigator owns the one-shot and clears
					// it in ITS handler for this same emission, so if that ran first we

					// awake, so a stale phantom cannot outlive it; and a phantom's
					// failure mode is a needlessly patched band from a clean chapter,
					// never baked chrome.
					if (rects.length === 0 && !pinSleepWatch.chromeHeld
							&& pinSleepWatch.lastChrome && pinSleepWatch.lastChrome.length
							&& (Date.now() - pinSleepWatch.lastChromeTs) < 45000)

	IMPORT common 1.0

	TRAVERSE BaseView#root

						iv.sort(function(a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; });
						var x = 0;
						for (j = 0; j < iv.length; j++) {
							if (iv[j][0] > x)
								out.push({ "x": x, "y": y0, "w": iv[j][0] - x, "h": y1 - y0 });
							x = Math.max(x, iv[j][1]);
						}
						if (x < W)
							out.push({ "x": x, "y": y0, "w": W - x, "h": y1 - y0 });
					}
					return out;
				}

				// NEVER blank the pin state up front: an intermediate "nothing pinned"
				// frame exposes the stock logo (whose path is invalid here -> error
				// placeholder), and on idle sleep that frame gets flushed to the EPD as
				// a white "reMarkable is sleeping" flash. State is only swapped once
				// the fresh json is in hand, and only if it actually changed — an
				// unchanged model keeps its delegates (and decoded images) alive.
				// Freeze decision, per sleep: the Visible content toggle must be on,
				// and either nothing is pinned (current screen everywhere) or the
				// sleep came in through light sleep (idle -> current, button -> pin).
				// Freeze shows current.bmp — the entry-instant fastshot BMP the
				// Navigator took synchronously — through the same full-bleed logo
				// path as legacy. The sync capture completes before the record is
				// written, so a readable record with captured=true guarantees the
				// file; the decode-error retry stays as pure fallback.
				function applyPower(text, pinned, pinnedOrient) {
					var p = null;
					try { p = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { }
					if (!p || p.next === undefined) {
						// unreadable or mid-write record: commit NOTHING — the
						// window stays undecided (placeholder) and the
						// recheck re-reads. Never default to the stock carousel
						// on a transient read failure.
						return;
					}
					var on = p.lightSleepEnabled === true;
					var fromLight = (p.prev === 1 && p.next === 2);
					var inSleep = (p.next === 2);
					var ts = p.ts || 0;
					// only freeze for the sleep we are IN (p.next === 2) and with a
					// shot from THIS entry — at wake p.next flips to 0 and an old ts
					// ages out, so the previous nap's screen can never flash again.
					// captured=false (fastshot failed) falls through to stock rather
					// than waiting for an image that will never appear; records
					// without the field (pre-v0.19) keep the old behavior.
					// INVARIANT: no new code path may call check() mid-nap. The 20s
					// freshness test flips freeze->false on any check() later than
					// that into the nap, and applyPinned populates pinSleepModel
					// regardless of freeze (only !pinSleepFreeze at :1376 hides it),
					// so the window would swap the frozen shot for the chapter stack
					// AND re-point pinSleepOrient at the book's value — a visible
					// mid-nap content+bar rotation, one full EPD refresh. The
					// existing recheck/retry timers are bounded to the entry.
					// p.forced (v0.37) is the toolbar long-press: "sleep now showing
					// THIS screen" must beat the pinned page on a button entry, which
					// is the one case the matrix otherwise resolves the other way. It
					// is a per-record flag on a one-shot arming, so it cannot leak into
					// a later nap: the ts freshness test above still applies and wake
					// flips p.next.
					root.pinSleepFreeze = on && (!pinned || fromLight || p.forced === true)
						&& inSleep && (Date.now() - ts < 20000)
						&& p.captured !== false;
					// all gates settle together in this one call so no frame can slip
					// between them. The likely-gate must equal the RESOLVED freeze: a
					// committed record that fails the freshness/captured test (stale
					// ts, failed shot) previously left freezeLikely stuck true with
					// freeze false — every stock element suppressed, black placeholder
					// latched on the EPD for the whole nap (v0.25 black-screen bug).
					root.pinSleepFreezeLikely = root.pinSleepFreeze;
					root.pinSleepPinnedLikely = pinned === true;
					// freeze wins: its orient is the entry instant, which is what the
					// current.bmp shot shows. Otherwise the pinned path takes the
					// book's capture-time orient (missing on pre-v0.34 records ->
					// undefined | 0 === 0, i.e. exactly the old behavior); the stock
					// carousel is never rotated.
					root.pinSleepOrient = root.pinSleepFreeze ? (p.orient | 0)
						: (pinned ? (pinnedOrient | 0) : 0);
					// dynamic verdict, sampled AFTER freeze/pinned/orient are
					// final for this record and BEFORE decided flips (one settle,
					// see the pinSleepVerdict declaration). Idempotent across
					// recheck calls: fixed rects over the same file. try/catch:
					// a verdict failure must never take the whole decide down —
					// null just means outline fail-safe (black ink, white halo).
					try {
						root.pinSleepVerdict = pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepVerdictNow();
					} catch (e) {
						// logged, not silent (v0.44.1 regression hunt): a broken
						// verdict path must be visible in the journal
						console.log("pinSleep verdict threw: " + e);
						root.pinSleepVerdict = null;
					}
					console.log("pinSleep applyPower: verdict="
						+ JSON.stringify(root.pinSleepVerdict)
						+ " freeze=" + root.pinSleepFreeze
						+ " pinned=" + (pinned === true)
						+ " t=" + Date.now());
					root.pinSleepDecided = true;
					// HUNT PROBE F (temporary, do not ship): six delayed
					// framebuffer captures per entry, consecutive-diffed on the
					// host — reconstructs the render TIMELINE (what appears when)
					// instead of two endpoints that cannot separate "window
					// rendered late" from "element popped after the latch".
					try {
						var pfd = [50, 150, 300, 500, 800, 1200];
						for (var pfi = 0; pfi < pfd.length; pfi++)
							pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastAsyncShot",
								"/tmp/pinnedSleep/dbg" + (pfi + 1) + ".bmp,"
								+ pfd[pfi]);
					} catch (e2) { console.log("pinSleep probeF threw: " + e2); }
					// HUNT PROBE G (temporary): was the battery value readable at
					// decide-time? Separates "async percentage arrives late" from
					// "compiled widget settles its layout late".
					try {
						console.log("pinSleep battProbe: pct="
							+ BatteryManager.battery.percentage
							+ " val=" + pinSleepIndicatorBattery.value
							+ " ih=" + pinSleepIndicatorBattery.implicitHeight
							+ " rowvis=" + pinSleepIndicatorBattRow.visible
							+ " t=" + Date.now());
					} catch (e3) { console.log("pinSleep battProbe threw: " + e3); }
					if (root.pinSleepFreeze) {
						// nonce = the entry's ts (same shot is not re-decoded on
						// re-checks); retries suffix still forces a re-read if a
						// decode ever fails
						root.pinSleepPath = "file:///tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp?v="
							+ ts + "." + pinSleepGate.retries;
					} else if (!pinned) {
						// decide owns the freeze path; pinned paths (chapters/legacy)
						// stay owned by check()
						root.pinSleepPath = "";
					}
				}

				function decide(pinned, pinnedOrient) {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						pinSleepGate.applyPower(xhr.responseText, pinned, pinnedOrient);
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// powerText === null -> the freeze decision goes through an async
				// decide(); a string (possibly "") decides synchronously in-line
				function applyPinned(text, powerText) {
					var j = null;
					try { j = JSON.parse(text); } catch (e) { }
					// tmpfs chapters die with a reboot while pinned.json persists —
					// verify existence BEFORE committing to the pinned path, so a
					// rebooted device falls to stock silently instead of raising
					// the failure page over an expected lifecycle event. (Navigator
					// persists/restores the chapters around reboots; this guard
					// covers pin-then-reboot-before-any-sleep and similar holes.)
					var chapters = (j && j.docId && j.chapters) ? j.chapters : [];
					// A chapter's PIXELS may also be older than the metadata that
					// describes them (v0.39): captureNow() publishes the book and only
					// then queues the detached grab, so for the length of the capture
					// delay — and forever if that grab fails — the reused ch1..ch3 name
					// still holds the PREVIOUS occupant's image, which right after a
					// re-pin is a DIFFERENT DOCUMENT's page. fastStat answers
					// "ok:<size>,<mtime_ms>"; a chapter counts only if its file's mtime
					// is not older than the entry's ts.
					// The tolerance is exactly ZERO, deliberately: both stamps come from
					// the same CLOCK_REALTIME and both floor to whole ms, and the write
					// always follows the ts, so mtime >= ts holds for every honest
					// chapter. Any positive slack would have to exceed the capture delays
					// (200-600ms) to buy anything — and that is precisely the window the
					// race lives in. The one false-drop source left is a backwards clock
					// step between save and grab, which fails toward stock, never toward
					// another document's pixels.
					// A chapter with no usable ts (pre-0.39 book) keeps the old
					// existence-only rule — the same fail-open stance the reboot refill
					// already takes: its `cp` does not preserve mtime, so refilled
					// chapters read as fresh and are shown.
					var avail = [];
					for (var ci = 0; ci < chapters.length; ci++) {
						var cf0 = "" + chapters[ci].file;
						var cd0 = cf0.indexOf(".bmp") > 0
							? "/tmp/pinnedSleep/" : "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/";
						var cst = "" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastStat", cd0 + cf0);
						if (!root.pinSleepReplyOk(cst)) continue;
						// never |0 a millisecond stamp — Date.now() overflows int32
						var cts = parseFloat(chapters[ci].ts);
						var cmt = parseFloat(cst.replace("ok:", "").split(",")[1]);
						if (isFinite(cts) && isFinite(cmt) && cmt < cts) continue;
						avail.push(chapters[ci]);
					}
					var pinned = !!(j && j.docId)
						&& (chapters.length === 0 || avail.length > 0);
					// raise the pinned pre-gate BEFORE any image decodes (a fresh
					// window must never flash the stock carousel while the chapter
					// model loads); LOWERING it is left to the power decision so
					// both gates always settle in the same update
					if (pinned) root.pinSleepPinnedLikely = true;
					// the book's orient rides along into applyPower instead of being
					// set here: on the async path the freeze decision lands a tick
					// later, and an orient committed early would disagree with it for
					// that tick (the gates settle in ONE update, never split)
					var bookOrient = (j && j.orient !== undefined) ? (j.orient | 0) : 0;
					if (powerText === null)
						pinSleepGate.decide(pinned, bookOrient);
					else
						pinSleepGate.applyPower(powerText, pinned, bookOrient);
					if (!pinned) { // unpinned, unreadable, or chapters lost to reboot
						root.pinSleepModel = [];
						root.pinSleepProbeSrc = "";
						return;
					}
					if (avail.length) {
						var W = root.width > 0 ? root.width : 954;
						var H = root.height > 0 ? root.height : 1696;
						var m = [];
						for (var i = 0; i < avail.length; i++) {
							// query string is a cache-buster only (dropped by the
							// file engine); retries forces a re-decode on error.
							// BMP chapters (v0.21+) live on tmpfs; legacy PNG entries
							// keep the old eMMC dir until the ring rotates them out
							var chFile = "" + avail[i].file;
							var chDir = chFile.indexOf(".bmp") > 0
								? "/tmp/pinnedSleep/" : "/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/";
							var src = "file://" + chDir + chFile
								+ "?v=" + (avail[i].ts || 0) + "." + pinSleepGate.retries;
							var free = pinSleepGate.complement(avail[i].chrome, W, H);
							for (var k = 0; k < free.length; k++) {
								m.push({ "src": src, "cx": free[k].x, "cy": free[k].y,
									"cw": free[k].w, "ch": free[k].h });
							}
						}
						if (JSON.stringify(m) !== JSON.stringify(root.pinSleepModel)) {
							root.pinSleepModel = m;
							root.pinSleepProbeSrc = m.length ? m[m.length - 1].src : "";
						}
						root.pinSleepPath = "";
					} else {
						// v1 state: single blind capture from pin time; the nonce
						// forces a re-read of the file (same string = no reload)
						root.pinSleepModel = [];
						root.pinSleepProbeSrc = "";
						root.pinSleepPath = "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.png?v=" + Date.now();
					}
				}

				function check() {
					var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
					xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
						if (xhr.readyState !== XMLHttpRequest.DONE) return;
						pinSleepGate.applyPinned(xhr.responseText, null);
					};
					xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					xhr.send();
				}

				// Decide BEFORE the window's first frame: fastRead is a genuinely
				// synchronous native call (in-thread, NO nested event loop — safe
				// where sync XHR is not), so the whole pin+freeze decision and the
				// image decode land in the first painted frame, which is what the
				// entry's own EPD refresh latches. Async check() stays the fallback
				// when fastshot is absent ("" reply — no handler for the signal).
				function syncDecide() {
					var pj = "" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
						"/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/pinned.json");
					var pw = "" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
						"/home/root/.pinnedSleepScreen/power.json");
					if (pj === "" && pw === "") return false;
					pinSleepGate.applyPinned(
						pj.indexOf("failed") === 0 ? "" : pj,
						pw.indexOf("failed") === 0 ? "" : pw);
					return true;
				}

				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepWinBroker
				}

				Component.onCompleted: {
					// orientation probe (v0.27.2): dump the window's Orientation
					// object once per sleep entry — maps the four orientations to
					// runtime property names for the bar-rotation feature. Fully
					// fenced: a probe error must never stall the decide path.
					try {
						var po = root.orientation, ps = "";
						for (var pk in po) {
							if (typeof po[pk] === "function") continue;
							ps += pk + "=" + po[pk] + " ";
						}
						try {
							ps += "| charger=" + BatteryManager.battery.chargerState
								+ " disc=" + Battery.Disconnected
								+ " chg=" + Battery.Charging;
						} catch (pe2) { ps += "| Battery enum unavailable"; }
						console.log("pinSleep orient: " + ps);
					} catch (pe) {
						console.log("pinSleep orient probe failed: " + pe);
					}
					if (!pinSleepGate.syncDecide()) pinSleepGate.check();
				}

				Connections {
					target: root
					function onVisibleChanged() {
						if (root.visible) {
							pinSleepGate.retries = 0;
							if (!pinSleepGate.syncDecide()) pinSleepGate.check();
							// power.json is written on the same state change that shows
							// this window, so the first read can race it — re-check
							// repeatedly until the freeze decision settles
							pinSleepRecheck.ticks = 0;
							pinSleepRecheck.restart();
						} else {
							// stale freeze must not leak into the next entry's first frame
							pinSleepRecheck.stop();
							root.pinSleepFreeze = false;
							root.pinSleepPath = "";
							root.pinSleepVerdict = null;
						}
					}
				}

				Timer {
					id: pinSleepRecheck
					// fast early cadence: the record is normally on disk before the
					// window exists (fastshot sidecar), so the first read settles it —
					// these quick ticks only matter when that write fell back to XHR
					interval: ticks < 8 ? 50 : 300
					repeat: true
					property int ticks: 0
					onTriggered: {
						ticks++;
						if (root.pinSleepFreeze || ticks > 16) { // settled (or ~2.8s cap)
							// give-up fallback: if every read failed (e.g. power.json
							// missing on a fresh install), accept stock rather than
							// staying white forever
							if (!root.pinSleepDecided) root.pinSleepDecided = true;
							stop();
							return;
						}
						pinSleepGate.check();
					}
				}

				// If sleep was pressed while rm-shot was still writing, the newest image
				// decodes as garbage and the window would show a broken screen for the
				// whole nap. Retry while the newest layer is in Error: check() rebuilds
				// with a fresh cache-buster once the file is complete.
				Timer {
					interval: 250
					repeat: true
					running: root.visible
						&& root.pinSleepPath !== ""
						&& logo.status === Image.Error
						&& pinSleepGate.retries < 8
					onTriggered: {
						pinSleepGate.retries++;
						pinSleepGate.check();
					}
				}

				Timer {
					interval: 250
					repeat: true
					running: root.visible
						&& root.pinSleepModel.length > 0
						&& pinSleepProbe.status === Image.Error
						&& pinSleepGate.retries < 8
					onTriggered: {
						pinSleepGate.retries++;
						pinSleepGate.check();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		REBUILD makeSleepScreenPath
			LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \ return \
			INSERT {
				if (root.pinSleepPath !== "") {
					path = root.pinSleepPath;
				}
			}
		END REBUILD

		TRAVERSE ?#logo
			LOCATE BEFORE ALL
			INSERT {
				cache: false
				// the stock logo has no visible binding of its own — hide it while a
				// freeze or chapter paint is pending (and on a newborn undecided
				// window) so it can never flash first
				visible: root.pinSleepPath !== ""
					|| (root.pinSleepDecided
						&& !root.pinSleepFreezeLikely && !root.pinSleepPinnedLikely)
			}
			REBUILD width
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepPath !== "" ? parent.width : }
			END REBUILD
			REBUILD height
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepPath !== "" ? parent.height : }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE ?#illustration
			REBUILD visible
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepDecided && !root.pinSleepFreezeLikely && !root.pinSleepPinnedLikely && !root.pinSleepFreeze && root.pinSleepPath === "" && root.pinSleepModel.length === 0 && }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		; the stock logo's path is invalid when the carousel is active, so this white
		; "reMarkable is sleeping" sheet is permanently "visible" underneath our layers
		; in chapters mode — keep it out entirely so no decode gap can ever expose it
		TRAVERSE ?#errorPlaceholder
			REBUILD visible
				LOCATE BEFORE ALL INSERT { root.pinSleepDecided && !root.pinSleepFreezeLikely && !root.pinSleepPinnedLikely && root.pinSleepModel.length === 0 && }
			END REBUILD
		END TRAVERSE

		TRAVERSE InputBlocker:contentItem
			; native owner name/contact ColumnLayout: painted BELOW our layers, so
			; it's invisible in chapters mode anyway — removed and replaced by our
			; bottom contacts bar (drawn above everything, stock carousel included)
			LOCATE BEFORE ColumnLayout
			REMOVE ColumnLayout
			LOCATE AFTER ALL
			INSERT {
				// pure-black placeholder while the mod owns the image but hasn't
				// painted it yet (undecided newborn window, or freeze/chapters still
				// loading); reverts to the stock white once content is up
				color: root.pinSleepBroken ? "white"
					: (!root.pinSleepDecided
						|| ((root.pinSleepFreezeLikely || root.pinSleepPinnedLikely)
							&& root.pinSleepModel.length === 0
							&& (root.pinSleepPath === "" || logo.status !== Image.Ready)))
						? "black" : "white"

				Item {
					id: pinSleepLayerHost
					anchors.fill: parent
					// hidden when broken: partially-decoded chapters must not sit
					// under the failure message (a good ch0 + bad ch1 rendered the
					// error page over half-correct imagery — user-observed)
					visible: root.pinSleepModel.length > 0 && !root.pinSleepFreeze
						&& !root.pinSleepBroken

					Repeater {
						model: root.pinSleepModel
						delegate: Item {
							clip: true
							x: modelData.cx
							y: modelData.cy
							width: modelData.cw
							height: modelData.ch
							Image {
								x: -modelData.cx
								y: -modelData.cy
								width: pinSleepLayerHost.width
								height: pinSleepLayerHost.height
								source: modelData.src
							}
						}
					}

					Image {
						id: pinSleepProbe
						visible: false
						width: 1
						height: 1
						source: root.pinSleepProbeSrc
					}
				}

				// FIX (flash hunt close, 2026-08-20): opaque band cover for the
				// translucent freeze bar. The EPD compositor issues a SECOND full
				// refresh (whole-screen white flash) for any sleep frame whose top
				// band is not covered by an opaque node — proven structural, not
				// pixel/timing-driven: probe timelines showed one render step and
				// a byte-static framebuffer in both the clean and flashing modes.
				// The cover is the capture's OWN band strip (same source, same
				// geometry, clipped) — structurally opaque, visually identical to
				// a transparent bar. Freeze only: pinned's slow first frame never
				// trips the second pass, so it keeps true transparency.
				Item {
					id: pinSleepBandCover
					visible: root.pinSleepDecided && root.pinSleepFreeze
						&& root.pinSleepPath !== ""
						&& Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "translucent"
					clip: true
					property int bh: Math.round(pinSleepIndicator.height)
					x: root.pinSleepOrient === 90 ? parent.width - bh : 0
					y: root.pinSleepOrient === 180 ? parent.height - bh : 0
					width: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? bh : parent.width
					height: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? parent.height : bh
					Image {
						cache: false
						fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
						source: pinSleepBandCover.visible ? root.pinSleepPath : ""
						width: pinSleepBandCover.parent.width
						height: pinSleepBandCover.parent.height
						x: -pinSleepBandCover.x
						y: -pinSleepBandCover.y
					}
				}

				Rectangle {
					id: pinSleepIndicator
					// on every deep-sleep screen since v0.26 — stock carousel included
					// (the old mod-owned-image gate was why carousel naps had no bar)
					visible: true
					// Style ink/paper (Values.pinSleepBarStyle, WP4a). EVERY test
					// is `=== "black"`, never `=== "white"`: an unknown value read
					// back from QSettings must degrade to the white bar, and
					// testing for "white" would hand it the black arm instead. In
					// the white case both values are the literals the bar carried
					// through v0.35.0, so that rendering is unchanged to the pixel.
					// Translucent takes the same arm on purpose: its glyphs are
					// BLACK cores with white outlines (owner ruling 2026-08-11,
					// A1) on every background, so its ink is the white style's.
					property color pinSleepPaper: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
						? "black" : "white"
					property color pinSleepInk: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
						? "white" : "black"
					// Dynamic style (v0.44, see the header): translucent keeps its
					// Settings name but always decides from the picture — a full
					// white borderless bar on an essentially-white band, outlined
					// per-run-polarity glyphs on anything else. Every binding
					// below gates on this flag, false for white AND black, so both
					// keep their v0.37.0 frames exactly.
					property bool pinSleepDynamic: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "translucent"
					// mockup unit: outline geometry is quoted at bar height 120
					// (research/halo-poc/strips.py:85-86), so it rides
					// pinSleepBarScale for free.
					property real pinSleepBarU: height / 120
					// halo ring offset: 3u is the v0.44 readability bump (2u read
					// thin on device, owner ruling 2026-08-20)
					// "+1px over v0.43", computed literally (v0.44.1): round(3*u)
					// on the Move bar (height ~81 -> u ~0.68) rounds back DOWN to
					// the old 2px — the owner measured no change. round(2u)+1 is
					// the previous ring grown by exactly one pixel at every scale.
					property int pinSleepHaloG: Math.max(1, Math.round(2 * pinSleepBarU)) + 1
					// The verdict is LATCHED, never a live binding (v0.44.1): the
					// v0.44 binding also read the runs' x/width, which settle
					// AFTER the first latched frame, so the bar flipped from the
					// undecided white default to transparent post-paint — a
					// 954x120 high-contrast change that escalated to a second
					// full EPD refresh, the owner's ~1s white flash (the capture
					// itself never regressed: grab-to-window stayed ~80ms).
					// root.pinSleepVerdict is computed ONCE per applyPower — the
					// same call that settles decided/freeze/orient/path — from
					// FIXED band fractions, so nothing it reads can move after
					// the frame it was chosen for. This also breaks the battery
					// feedback edge for real (v0.44's header claimed no loop, but
					// the token clone could move implicitWidth -> Row width ->
					// the sampled rect): the verdict no longer reads any geometry
					// a verdict can influence. Undecided/unreadable/carousel =
					// null = TRANSPARENT bar with black ink in a white halo — the
					// outline reads on any background (owner's own principle),
					// and painting nothing until the verdict exists means the
					// white bar can never appear and then retract.
					property bool pinSleepWhiteBar: pinSleepDynamic
						&& root.pinSleepVerdict !== null
						&& root.pinSleepVerdict.whiteBar === true
					property bool pinSleepHalo: pinSleepDynamic && !pinSleepWhiteBar
					// single bar-wide polarity (owner ruling 2026-08-20: on
					// mid-tone images split per-run votes read as inconsistency,
					// and the opposite-color halo already guarantees legibility
					// wherever the shared verdict is locally wrong)

						&& root.pinSleepVerdict !== null
						&& root.pinSleepVerdict.whiteInk === true

						? (pinSleepInkW ? "white" : "black") : pinSleepInk
					// the one battery icon (stock widget) inverts for the black
					// style and for a white-voted dynamic bar alike

						|| pinSleepInkW
					// guarded: the flag can settle during window construction,
					// before the indicator instantiates (its own onCompleted

						if (pinSleepIndicatorBattery)
