					}
					// flash hunt (v0.44.1): timestamp every treatment edge — a
					// flip logged well after the entry's applyPower line is the
					// post-frame repaint that forces the second EPD refresh
					onPinSleepWhiteBarChanged: console.log(
						"pinSleep edge: whiteBar=" + pinSleepWhiteBar
						+ " t=" + Date.now())
					onPinSleepInkWChanged: console.log(
						"pinSleep edge: inkW=" + pinSleepInkW
						+ " t=" + Date.now())
					onPinSleepHaloChanged: console.log(
						"pinSleep edge: halo=" + pinSleepHalo
						+ " t=" + Date.now())
					// Called by applyPower (and only there — journal-proven fix,
					// 2026-08-20 late-night round: at gate onCompleted the bar
					// has its HEIGHT but the window is not sized yet, so any
					// window/parent width here is 0. The v0.44.1 width-edge
					// recovery recomputed the verdict ~40ms later, AFTER the
					// freeze path's first EPD latch — the black->white ink flip
					// then forced the second full refresh, which IS the flash.
					// Pinned never flashed only because its chapters arrive via
					// async reads, landing the first latch after the flip.).
					// The band therefore samples in PHYSICAL image coordinates:
					// the image's size is fixed and known to fastshot (negative
					// x/y = from the far edge, >=0.11.0), so the verdict needs
					// only the bar HEIGHT and the orientation — both valid at
					// first applyPower, before anything is latched. Returns
					// null when there is nothing readable: not dynamic, stock
					// carousel, legacy PNG chapters, absent/old fastshot.
					function pinSleepVerdictNow() {
						if (!pinSleepDynamic) return null;
						var f = root.pinSleepFreeze;
						if (!f && !root.pinSleepPinnedLikely) return null;
						var img = f ? "/tmp/pinnedSleep/current.bmp"
							: "/tmp/pinnedSleep/ch0.bmp";
						// the band the bar covers, in the frame the BMP stores:
						// orient 0 top / 90 right / 180 bottom / 270 left edge
						// (the same four cases the on-screen strip rotates by).
						// 999999 spans the full edge — fastshot clamps to the
						// image, so no window dimension is ever needed.
						var o = root.pinSleepOrient, h = Math.round(height);
						var band = o === 90 ? [-h, 0, h, 999999]
							: (o === 180 ? [0, -h, 999999, h]
							: (o === 270 ? [0, 0, h, 999999]
							: [0, 0, 999999, h]));
						// 24x2 cells along the bar, every 8th row: ~15 preads,
						// sub-ms, scales to a Pro frame (the v0.44 full-area
						// reads were the maximally dumb version — owner note)
						var cells = pinSleepLumaCells(img, band,
							o === 90 || o === 270, 24, 2, 8);
						if (!cells) {
							console.log("pinSleep verdict: no cells (" + img
								+ " o=" + o + " h=" + h + ")");
							return null;
						}
						// White-page test: every cell OUTSIDE the fixed text
						// fractions must be bright AND unsaturated — chroma is
						// what tells WHITE from LIGHT (a uniform light blue means
						// ~205 luma and sailed through the v0.44 test; its chroma
						// is ~50, white/grey is ~0). Cells under a run count as
						// white because the render covers them (white bar or
						// glyphs), so strokes beneath the text cannot veto. The
						// fractions are generous supersets of the layout at both
						// orientations: date hugs the left, clock the center,
						// battery the right — the gaps between them are where
						// content shows through, and those gaps are the test.
						var whiteBar = true;

							var fx = ((i % 24) + 0.5) / 24;
							if (fx < 0.28 || (fx > 0.38 && fx < 0.62) || fx > 0.72)

								break;

						// polarity: one majority vote by AREA over ALL cells (a
						// flat average lets one bright half outvote a black half
						// pixel-for-pixel; cells vote by region)
						var dark = 0;
						for (var j = 0; j < cells.length; j++)
							if (cells[j].l < 128) dark++;
						// diagnostic (v0.44.1 regression hunt): one line per
						// computed verdict, cheap enough to keep

							+ cells.length + " whiteBar=" + whiteBar
							+ " l0=" + cells[0].l + " c0=" + cells[0].c
							+ " t=" + Date.now());

					}
					// physical-frame rect -> cell lumas in BAR-LOCAL order.
					// `rot` = the strip is rotated 90/270, so the bar's LONG
					// axis is the image's Y: the grid is requested transposed
					// (nx cells must divide the bar's length, not its
					// thickness — the v0.44/v0.44.1 sampler gridded rotated
					// bars across the 83px thickness, a real bug) and remapped
					// back so callers always index 24-along-the-bar. 180/270
					// reverse the along-bar direction, which is deliberately
					// NOT unmirrored: the text fractions are symmetric
					// (.28/.72) and the votes are order-free. Native side
					// clamps the rect; negative x/y = from the far edge
					// (>=0.11.0). QML cannot sample pixels synchronously and a
					// Canvas sampler paints async — fastLuma (>=0.10.0 for the
					// row step and the l:c chroma pairs; 0.9.0 answers
					// luma-only cells -> chroma reads 0; older builds answer
					// the single mean, replicated into every cell so the vote
					// degrades to the average) reads the BMP directly.
					function pinSleepLumaCells(img, r, rot, nx, ny, step) {
						var pnx = rot ? ny : nx, pny = rot ? nx : ny;
						var ret = "" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastLuma",
							img + "\n" + Math.round(r[0]) + "," + Math.round(r[1])
							+ "," + Math.round(r[2]) + "," + Math.round(r[3])
							+ "\n" + pnx + "," + pny + "," + step);
						if (ret.indexOf("ok:") !== 0) return null;
						var vs = ret.slice(3).split(",");
						var out = [];
						for (var i = 0; i < nx * ny; i++) {
							var part = ("" + (vs.length === 1 ? vs[0] : vs[i]))
								.split(":");
							var l = parseInt(part[0], 10);
							if (isNaN(l)) return null;
							var c = part.length > 1 ? parseInt(part[1], 10) : 0;
							// physical row-major -> bar-local row-major: for a
							// rotated strip, physical row = along-bar column
							// and physical column = bar row
							var bi = rot
								? (i % pnx) * nx + Math.floor(i / pnx) : i;
							out[bi] = { "l": l, "c": isNaN(c) ? 0 : c };
						}
						return out;
					}
					// Inverted token clone for the black style's battery (v0.42.1,
					// see the header): deep-copy the LIVE primary token, flip every
					// color. A QML color enumerates r/g/b/a with valid=true — that
					// is the recursion's leaf test. Returns null on any surprise so
					// the caller can fall back to `highlighted`.
					function pinSleepInvTok() {
						function inv(o) {
							if (o && typeof o === "object" && o.valid === true
									&& o.r !== undefined)
								return Qt.rgba(1 - o.r, 1 - o.g, 1 - o.b, o.a);
							if (o === null || typeof o !== "object") return o;
							var r = {};
							for (var k in o) {
								if (k === "objectName") continue;
								r[k] = inv(o[k]);
							}
							return r;
						}
						try { return inv(ArkTokens.BatteryIndicator.primary); }
						catch (e) { return null; }
					}
					// dynamic resolves to a literal white (not pinSleepPaper) so an
					// unknown future style value can never paint a black bar here.
					// UNDECIDED is transparent, never white (v0.44.1): the white
					// bar only ever appears once the verdict says so, so it can
					// never appear and then retract into a second EPD refresh
					color: !pinSleepDynamic ? pinSleepPaper
						: (pinSleepWhiteBar ? "white" : "transparent")
					// +17 not +16: the border is drawn INSIDE the bar, so covering
					// the taller native toolbar needs bar height, not border width
					height: pinSleepIndicatorTime.height + 17

					// locale-aware, not hardcoded: month-day order and 12/24h come
					// from the system locale (hardcoded dd/MM was a bug for US users)
					function fmtDate(d) {
						var f = Qt.locale().dateFormat(Locale.ShortFormat);
						var mFirst = f.indexOf("M") !== -1 && f.indexOf("M") < f.indexOf("d");
						var s = Qt.formatDateTime(d, mFirst ? "ddd, MMM d" : "ddd, d MMM");
						return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
					}
					function fmtTime(d) {
						var tf = Qt.locale().timeFormat(Locale.ShortFormat);
						return Qt.formatTime(d, tf.toLowerCase().indexOf("ap") !== -1
							? "h:mm AP" : "hh:mm");
					}

					// A live deep-sleep clock exists only with the pinned-sleep-clock
					// companion (its WakeSystem timer thaws the repaints). Without
					// it the time would freeze at entry and lie all nap — fall back
					// to the static "Sleeping" centerpiece instead. The unit file's
					// existence IS the opt-in signal (install writes it, purge
					// removes it); evaluated once per window birth.
					// (an empty reply = fastshot absent = we know nothing, so no clock)
					property bool pinSleepHasClock: root.pinSleepReplyOk(
						pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal(
							"fastRead", "/etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer"))

					// bolt gate from the KERNEL charger status — the QML-side
					// Battery enum comparison silently mistracked (bolt stuck on).
					// Optimistic UX: charger `online` flips at VBUS (insertion),
					// seconds before charging negotiates — show the bolt then, and
					// retract after a 3s grace in the rare charge-failure case.
					function chargeNow() {
						var on = ("" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
							"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818-charger/online"))
							.indexOf("1") === 0;
						if (!on) return false;
						var cs = "" + pinSleepWinBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
							"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818_battery/status");
						return cs.indexOf("Charging") === 0 || cs.indexOf("Full") === 0;
					}
					// initialized synchronously so the bolt is in the FIRST painted
					// frame (the one the EPD latches) — the timer only tracks changes
					property bool pinSleepCharging: chargeNow()
					property bool pinSleepWasOnline: pinSleepCharging
					property int pinSleepGrace: 0
					// Sits on the CONTENT-TOP edge (where the document toolbar lives
					// in the frozen image), reading upright in the content's own
					// orientation. pinSleepOrient: 0 top / 90 right / 180 bottom
					// upside-down / 270 left. TopLeft-origin rotations: the strip
					// hugs the target edge with the text tops facing content-up.
					x: root.pinSleepOrient === 90 ? parent.width : 0
					y: root.pinSleepOrient === 180 ? parent.height - height
						: (root.pinSleepOrient === 270 ? parent.height : 0)
					width: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? parent.height : parent.width
					transformOrigin: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? Item.TopLeft : Item.Center
					rotation: root.pinSleepOrient
					// full-width bar, bottom border only — and WHITE style only
					// (owner ruling 2026-08-19): there is no natural black page, so
					// the black strip needs no seam — a white rule on it reads as
					// decoration. Dynamic never draws it either (2026-08-20): the
					// white-bar outcome exists to BLEND into a white page and the
					// border is the one thing that would give it away; on the
					// outline outcome a rule across the picture reads as a
					// scratch, not as a seam.
					Rectangle {
						visible: !pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepDynamic
							&& Values.pinSleepBarStyle !== "black"
						anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom }
						height: 4
						color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepInk
					}
					// Opaque glyph halos (v0.43, ring reworked v0.44): 8 same-size
					// copies of each string in a ring under its core — declared
					// BEFORE the glyphs so painting order stacks them underneath
					// (a Rectangle's children paint in declaration order; no z
					// juggling). Copies live on the BAR and position by reading
					// the target's x/y, never inside the battery Row: a Row lays
					// out every visible child and the ring would shove the real
					// glyphs aside. `font: target.font` copies the whole group, so
					// any future size/weight change follows automatically. The
					// color is the run ink's OPPOSITE (v0.44): a white-voted run
					// gets a black halo.
					Repeater {
						model: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHalo ? 8 : 0
						delegate: Text {
							required property int index
							property int g: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHaloG
							x: pinSleepIndicatorStamp.x + [-g, g, 0, 0, -g, g, -g, g][index]
							y: pinSleepIndicatorStamp.y + [0, 0, -g, g, -g, -g, g, g][index]
							visible: pinSleepIndicatorStamp.visible
							text: pinSleepIndicatorStamp.text
							font: pinSleepIndicatorStamp.font
							antialiasing: false
							color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepInkW ? "black" : "white"
						}
					}
					Repeater {
						model: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHalo ? 8 : 0
						delegate: Text {
							required property int index
							property int g: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHaloG
							x: pinSleepIndicatorTime.x + [-g, g, 0, 0, -g, g, -g, g][index]
							y: pinSleepIndicatorTime.y + [0, 0, -g, g, -g, -g, g, g][index]
							text: pinSleepIndicatorTime.text
							font: pinSleepIndicatorTime.font
							antialiasing: false
							color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepInkW ? "black" : "white"
						}
					}
					Repeater {
						model: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHalo ? 8 : 0
						delegate: Text {
							required property int index
							property int g: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHaloG
							// the % text is laid out by its Row — map through it

							y: pinSleepIndicatorBattRow.y + pinSleepIndicatorBattPct.y
								+ [0, 0, -g, g, -g, -g, g, g][index]
							visible: pinSleepIndicatorBattRow.visible
							text: pinSleepIndicatorBattPct.text

							antialiasing: false
							color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepInkW ? "black" : "white"
						}
					}
					// left: date + time, Quick-Panel-Time style (07/08 18:12).
					// Repaints are quiet regional EPD updates (verified); frozen
					// through suspend, thawed by the pinsleep-clock.timer wakes
					// (WakeSystem=true, 5-min marks), live-ticking in light sleep.
					// left: "Wed, 6 Aug" — secondary info at 3/4 size, regular weight
					Text {
						id: pinSleepIndicatorStamp
						font.pixelSize: Math.round(Values.fontSizeBody1 * 1.5
							* root.pinSleepBarScale)
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						// per-run ink (v0.44): === pinSleepInk except in dynamic
						// mode, so the white/black bars are untouched to the
						// pixel; the opaque halo under this core is the ring of
						// opposite-color copies declared above the glyphs
						color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepGlyphInk
						property string stamp: pinSleepIndicator.fmtDate(new Date())
						text: stamp
						visible: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHasClock
						anchors { left: parent.left; leftMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
					}
					// center: the TIME is the centerpiece — big and bold ("Sleeping"
					// retired in v0.29: the bar's presence already says it)
					Text {
						id: pinSleepIndicatorTime
						// bar height rides on this text (+17), so the strip grows with
						// the scale on its own — the constant stays absolute (border)
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1 * 2 * root.pinSleepBarScale
						font.bold: true
						antialiasing: false
						color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepGlyphInk // see the date stamp
						property string t: pinSleepIndicator.fmtTime(new Date())
						// cadence 0 = Never: clock hidden, date/battery stay (they
						// refresh on natural wakes only — no timer wakes exist)
						text: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHasClock
							&& Values.pinSleepClockCadence > 0 ? t : qsTr("Sleeping")
						anchors.centerIn: parent
					}
					// right: battery icon + percentage (fuel-gauge sysfs via
					// fastRead — sub-ms; text repaints only when the value moves,
					// which at sleep drain rates is roughly hourly for free)

					// The ark widget's showValue/showCharging placed things oddly and
					// its internals are compiled — so it serves as the bare icon only.
					Row {
						// the dynamic sampler and the % halo track the group's
						// x/y/width through this id
						id: pinSleepIndicatorBattRow
						visible: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepHasClock
							&& pinSleepIndicatorBattery.value > 0
						// HUNT PROBE G (temporary): timestamp the pop
						onVisibleChanged: console.log("pinSleep battRow: visible="
							+ visible + " t=" + Date.now())
						spacing: 8
						anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
						// stock icon scaled UP to the % text height (rm sizes text down to
						// the icon; ours goes the other way so both match the bar's type)
						// v0.44: the stock widget is the ONLY battery icon (the
						// mod-drawn twin is retired, see the header) — the inverted
						// token clone drives its polarity for the black style and a
						// white-voted dynamic battery run alike, applied by
						// pinSleepApplyTok from onCompleted AND from the flag's
						// change signal (the dynamic verdict settles with decide(),

						Item {

							width: pinSleepIndicatorBattery.implicitWidth * f
							height: pinSleepIndicatorBattPct.height
							anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
							ArkControls.BatteryIndicator {

								showCharging: false
								showWarning: false
								showValue: false

								source: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepBattWhite

									: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepBolt.svg"

							font.weight: Font.Medium
							antialiasing: false
							color: pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepGlyphInk // see the date stamp

					Timer {

						repeat: true

						onTriggered: {

								.indexOf("1") === 0;

							var chg = cs.indexOf("Charging") === 0 || cs.indexOf("Full") === 0;
							if (!on) {
								pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepGrace = 0;
								pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepCharging = false;
							} else if (chg) {
								pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepGrace = 0;
								pinSleepIndicator.pinSleepCharging = true;

				// bottom contacts bar — replaces the removed native name/contact

				Rectangle {
					id: pinSleepContacts
					visible: root.isettings.idleDetailsVisible === true
						&& (pinSleepContactsName.text !== "" || pinSleepContactsInfo.text !== "")
					// inverts with the black style (owner ruling 2026-08-19, v0.42);
					// translucent keeps the white strip — the dynamic treatment is
					// the clock bar's, and outline-less text over the picture is
					// banned
					property color pinSleepCPaper: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
						? "black" : "white"
					property color pinSleepCInk: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
						? "white" : "black"
					color: pinSleepCPaper
					// +18/-3: taller bar biased downward — descenders (g j y)
					// were touching the screen edge at +8 centered
					height: Math.max(pinSleepContactsName.implicitHeight,
						pinSleepContactsInfo.implicitHeight) + 18
					// CONTENT-BOTTOM edge — the opposite edge from the clock bar,
					// same rotation (see pinSleepIndicator for the geometry notes)
					x: root.pinSleepOrient === 90 ? height
						: (root.pinSleepOrient === 270 ? parent.width - height : 0)
					y: root.pinSleepOrient === 0 ? parent.height - height
						: (root.pinSleepOrient === 270 ? parent.height : 0)
					width: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? parent.height : parent.width
					transformOrigin: (root.pinSleepOrient === 90 || root.pinSleepOrient === 270)
						? Item.TopLeft : Item.Center
					rotation: root.pinSleepOrient
					// top border, half the clock bar's weight (settings dividers use
					// 2) — WHITE strip only, same ruling as the clock bar's seam
					Rectangle {
						visible: Values.pinSleepBarStyle !== "black"
						anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top }
						height: 2
						color: "black"
					}
					Text {
						id: pinSleepContactsName
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						color: pinSleepContacts.pinSleepCInk
						text: "" + (root.isettings.idleName || "")
						anchors { left: parent.left; leftMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; verticalCenterOffset: -3 }
					}
					Text {
						id: pinSleepContactsInfo
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						color: pinSleepContacts.pinSleepCInk
						text: "" + (root.isettings.idleContact || "")
						anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter; verticalCenterOffset: -3 }
					}
				}

				// failure page: white + calm explanation (see pinSleepBroken).
				// The clock bar above stays alive — itself a sign the device is
				// fine and merely sleeping.
				Column {
					visible: root.pinSleepBroken
					spacing: 24
					width: parent.width - 160
					anchors.centerIn: parent
					Text {
						width: parent.width
						horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
						wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1 * 2
						font.bold: true
						antialiasing: false
						text: qsTr("Couldn't load the sleep image")
					}
					Text {
						width: parent.width
						horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
						wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
						font.pixelSize: Math.round(Values.fontSizeBody1 * 1.5)
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						text: qsTr("Everything is fine — the device is sleeping normally and your notes are safe.")
					}
					Text {
						width: parent.width
						horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
						wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
						font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						text: qsTr("If this keeps happening, restart the device (hold the power button) and please report it:")
							+ "\ngithub.com/YanGeruch/pinnedPageSleepScreen/issues"
					}
				}
			}
		END TRAVERSE
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Light-sleep banner window (the native "visible content" idle retention shows
; this OVER the frozen screen). Replace the stock bottom ActionBar with the
; same corner pill as the deep-sleep window. Light sleep keeps the CPU (and
; QML timers) running, so the clock ticks live every minute here — the
; quarter-hour wake timer only matters after the deep transition.
; (Replaces the retired miniLightSleep.qmd, which owned this ActionBar swap.)
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/modules/sleepscreen/qml/SleepWindowBannerWindow.qml
	IMPORT device.ui.text 1.0
	IMPORT common 1.0
	IMPORT com.remarkable 1.0
	IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
	; the deep-sleep window imports this itself; the banner file does not —
	; needed by the battery token clone (same alias form probeIconSource used)
	IMPORT ark.tokens as ArkTokens
	; mirrored from the deep-sleep bar (see there for the full rationale): short
	; screen edge, not width — this window inherits app rotation, so its width is
	; the 1696 long edge in landscape and would upsize the Move. Own TRAVERSE: the
	; pill's traverse lands on the contentItem, and the property must sit on root.
	TRAVERSE BaseView#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			function pinSleepPanelScale() {
				try {
					return Math.min(Screen.width, Screen.height) >= 1400 ? 1.35 : 1.0;
				} catch (e) {
					return 1.0;
				}
			}
			property real pinSleepBarScale: pinSleepPanelScale()

			// mirrored from the deep-sleep bar (v0.39): a broker reply is good news
			// only when it is NON-EMPTY and does not start with "failed" — the empty
			// string means no handler is registered (fastshot absent/too old), which
			// the old test read as "the file exists". Copied rather than shared: the
			// two bars live in different QML files, exactly as convention #5 says.
			function pinSleepReplyOk(r) {
				var s = "" + r;
				return s !== "" && s.indexOf("failed") !== 0;
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE BaseView#root > InputBlocker:contentItem
		LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.ActionBar
		REMOVE ArkControls.ActionBar
		INSERT {
			Rectangle {
				id: pinSleepBannerPill
				// mirrored from the deep-sleep bar: every test is `=== "black"`
				// so translucent falls to the white arm here.
				// DELIBERATE NON-MIRROR (convention #5, owner ruling 2026-08-11,
				// unchanged by v0.44): the dynamic treatment stops at the
				// deep-sleep bar. This window composites over the LIVE frame —
				// there is no capture and no freeze record to measure, so the
				// dynamic sampler would have nothing to sample, and a see-through
				// bar would show the running app's own top chrome, which this
				// pill and its bottom border exist to cover. Light sleep is
				// transient besides; dynamic is a sleep-WALLPAPER treatment.
				property color pinSleepPaper: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
					? "black" : "white"
				property color pinSleepInk: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
					? "white" : "black"
				color: pinSleepPaper
				height: pinSleepBannerTime.height + 17

				// same locale-aware formats as the deep-sleep bar
				function fmtDate(d) {
					var f = Qt.locale().dateFormat(Locale.ShortFormat);
					var mFirst = f.indexOf("M") !== -1 && f.indexOf("M") < f.indexOf("d");
					var s = Qt.formatDateTime(d, mFirst ? "ddd, MMM d" : "ddd, d MMM");
					return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
				}
				function fmtTime(d) {
					var tf = Qt.locale().timeFormat(Locale.ShortFormat);
					return Qt.formatTime(d, tf.toLowerCase().indexOf("ap") !== -1
						? "h:mm AP" : "hh:mm");
				}

				// see deep-sleep bar: companion detection + kernel-status bolt gate
				property bool pinSleepHasClock: root.pinSleepReplyOk(
					pinSleepBannerBroker.sendSimpleSignal(
						"fastRead", "/etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer"))
				function chargeNow() {
					var on = ("" + pinSleepBannerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
						"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818-charger/online"))
						.indexOf("1") === 0;
					if (!on) return false;
					var cs = "" + pinSleepBannerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
						"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818_battery/status");
					return cs.indexOf("Charging") === 0 || cs.indexOf("Full") === 0;
				}
				property bool pinSleepCharging: chargeNow()
				property bool pinSleepWasOnline: pinSleepCharging
				property int pinSleepGrace: 0
				// inverted token clone, mirrored from the deep-sleep bar (v0.42.1,
				// convention #5) — see there and the header for the full rationale
				function pinSleepInvTok() {
					function inv(o) {
						if (o && typeof o === "object" && o.valid === true
								&& o.r !== undefined)
							return Qt.rgba(1 - o.r, 1 - o.g, 1 - o.b, o.a);
						if (o === null || typeof o !== "object") return o;
						var r = {};
						for (var k in o) {
							if (k === "objectName") continue;
							r[k] = inv(o[k]);
						}
						return r;
					}
					try { return inv(ArkTokens.BatteryIndicator.primary); }
					catch (e) { return null; }
				}
				anchors {
					left: parent.left
					right: parent.right
					top: parent.top
				}
				XoviMessageBroker {
					id: pinSleepBannerBroker
				}
				// full-width bar, bottom border only — WHITE style only, mirrored
				// from the deep-sleep bar's v0.42 ruling. The PILL covers the
				// toolbar seam; the border only drew the contrast line.
				Rectangle {
					visible: Values.pinSleepBarStyle !== "black"
					anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom }
					height: 4
					color: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepInk
				}
				Text {
					id: pinSleepBannerStamp
					font.pixelSize: Math.round(Values.fontSizeBody1 * 1.5
						* root.pinSleepBarScale)
					font.weight: Font.Medium
					antialiasing: false
					color: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepInk
					property string stamp: pinSleepBannerPill.fmtDate(new Date())
					text: stamp
					visible: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepHasClock
					anchors { left: parent.left; leftMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
				}
				Text {
					id: pinSleepBannerTime
					// pill height rides on this text (+17) — same as the deep-sleep bar
					font.pixelSize: Values.fontSizeBody1 * 2 * root.pinSleepBarScale
					font.bold: true
					antialiasing: false
					color: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepInk
					property string t: pinSleepBannerPill.fmtTime(new Date())
					// cadence 0 = Never — same gate as the deep-sleep bar
					text: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepHasClock
						&& Values.pinSleepClockCadence > 0 ? t : qsTr("Sleeping")
					anchors.centerIn: parent
				}
				// right block, user-specified order: percentage, bolt (only while
				// a charger is attached), stock segmented battery icon rightmost.
				// The ark widget's showValue/showCharging placed things oddly and
				// its internals are compiled — so it serves as the bare icon only.
				Row {
					visible: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepHasClock
						&& pinSleepBannerBattery.value > 0
					spacing: 8
					anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 24; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
					// stock icon scaled UP to the % text height (rm sizes text down to
					// the icon; ours goes the other way so both match the bar's type).
					// v0.42.1: the stock widget serves both styles — the black arm
					// feeds it the inverted token clone, so the banner's mod-drawn
					// twin is GONE (the banner never had island styles to keep it for)
					Item {
						property real f: pinSleepBannerBattPct.height
							/ Math.max(1, pinSleepBannerBattery.implicitHeight)
						width: pinSleepBannerBattery.implicitWidth * f
						height: pinSleepBannerBattPct.height
						anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
						ArkControls.BatteryIndicator {
							id: pinSleepBannerBattery
							value: BatteryManager.battery.percentage
							showCharging: false
							showWarning: false
							showValue: false
							scale: parent.f
							transformOrigin: Item.TopLeft
							// onCompleted, not a binding — see the deep-sleep bar
							Component.onCompleted: {
								if (Values.pinSleepBarStyle !== "black") return;
								var t = pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepInvTok();
								if (t) pinSleepBannerBattery.type = t;
								else pinSleepBannerBattery.highlighted = true;
							}
						}
						// charging bolt OVERLAYS the icon center — the % text carries
						// readability, the bolt only flags external power.
						// static SVG bolt — see deep-sleep bar; inverted asset on the
						// black arm so the white core reads on the lit cells
						Image {
							visible: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepCharging
							source: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === "black"
								? "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepBoltInv.svg"
								: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepBolt.svg"
							width: Math.round(pinSleepBannerBattPct.height * 0.62)
							height: Math.round(pinSleepBannerBattPct.height * 1.3)
							sourceSize.width: width
							sourceSize.height: height
							anchors.centerIn: parent
						}
					}
					Text {
						id: pinSleepBannerBattPct
						// icon f and bolt derive from THIS height — scale applied once
						font.pixelSize: Math.round(Values.fontSizeBody1 * 1.5
							* root.pinSleepBarScale)
						font.weight: Font.Medium
						antialiasing: false
						color: pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepInk
						text: pinSleepBannerBattery.value + "%"
						anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
					}
				}
				Timer {
					interval: 1000
					repeat: true
					triggeredOnStart: true
					running: pinSleepBannerPill.visible && pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepHasClock
					onTriggered: {
						var on = ("" + pinSleepBannerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
							"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818-charger/online"))
							.indexOf("1") === 0;
						var cs = "" + pinSleepBannerBroker.sendSimpleSignal("fastRead",
							"/sys/class/power_supply/max77818_battery/status");
						var chg = cs.indexOf("Charging") === 0 || cs.indexOf("Full") === 0;
						if (!on) {
							pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepGrace = 0;
							pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepCharging = false;
						} else if (chg) {
							pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepGrace = 0;
							pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepCharging = true;
						} else {
							if (!pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepWasOnline)
								pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepGrace = 3;
							if (pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepGrace > 0) {
								pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepGrace--;
								pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepCharging = true;
							} else {
								pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepCharging = false;
							}
						}
						pinSleepBannerPill.pinSleepWasOnline = on;
						var d = new Date();
						var t = pinSleepBannerPill.fmtTime(d);
						var ds = pinSleepBannerPill.fmtDate(d);
						if (pinSleepBannerTime.t === t
								&& pinSleepBannerStamp.stamp === ds)
							return;
						pinSleepBannerTime.t = t;
						pinSleepBannerStamp.stamp = ds;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; The cadence + style store: Values is an engine-wide singleton, so the Display
; panel, the Navigator re-assert and both sleep bars see the same value.
AFFECT /qml/common/Values.qml
	IMPORT QtCore 6.5
	TRAVERSE Item
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			property alias pinSleepClockCadence: pinSleepValueStore.pinSleepClockCadence
			property alias pinSleepBarStyle: pinSleepValueStore.pinSleepBarStyle
			property alias pinSleepForceFreeze: pinSleepValueStore.pinSleepForceFreeze

			Item {
				id: pinSleepValueStore
				// minutes between sleep-clock updates; 0 = Never. 5 matches
				// the companion's shipped default cadence.
				property int pinSleepClockCadence: 5

				// "white" (white bar, black glyphs) | "black" (inverted) |
				// "translucent" (dynamic, v0.44 — the old tier-3 sub-style
				// key pinSleepTranslucentStyle is retired; a leftover ini
				// entry is simply never read). Default "white" IS the
				// v0.35.0 rendering: every style binding in the two bars
				// tests for "black", so both other values are the old
				// literals. An unknown value read back from QSettings
				// therefore degrades to the white bar, never to a blank one.
				property string pinSleepBarStyle: "white"
				// one-shot arming stamp for the toolbar's long-press "sleep now
				// with this screen" (Date.now() at press; the Navigator clears
				// it at the next transition). DELIBERATELY NOT in the Settings
				// block below: persisting it would let a crash between press
				// and suspend arm the next boot's first sleep. `real`, not
				// `int` — Date.now() overflows a 32-bit int.
				property real pinSleepForceFreeze: 0

				Settings {
					category: "pinnedSleep"
					property alias pinSleepClockCadence: pinSleepValueStore.pinSleepClockCadence
					property alias pinSleepBarStyle: pinSleepValueStore.pinSleepBarStyle
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Display > "Sleep clock": toggle + 1/5/15-minute menu, mirroring the
; Battery > Standby pattern (ArkToggleWrapper action, activate() flips
; 0<->default, showAttachment gates the ContextualMenu; off = 0 keeps the
; "Sleeping" centerpiece). Three options fit full-word labels in portrait
; where the old four-option row overflowed. Panels must LOCATE BEFORE
; Repeater — a ColumnLayout child placed after it collides with the
; Repeater's re-inserted delegates.
; Display > "Sleep screen style" follows in the same insert: the strip's
; white/black/translucent radio plus the translucent sub-style radio.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/settings/Display.qml
	IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
	TRAVERSE DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler#root > ScrollArea#flickable > Item#itemWrapper > ColumnLayout#column
		LOCATE BEFORE Repeater
		INSERT {
			ArkControls.Panel {
				id: pinSleepClockPanel
				Layout.fillWidth: true
				label: qsTr("Sleep clock")
				description: qsTr("Keep the time visible in standby.")

				CommandExecutor {
					id: pinSleepClockCmd
				}

				function activate() {
					if (Values.pinSleepClockCadence === 0) {
						pinSleepClockPanel.apply(5);
					} else {
						pinSleepClockPanel.apply(0);
					}
				}

				// cadence in minutes, 0 = off. The timer must follow the
				// setting now and after any reboot — the Navigator re-assert
				// replays this same script from the persisted value.
				function apply(mins) {
					Values.pinSleepClockCadence = mins;
					if (mins > 0) {
						pinSleepClockCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							"if [ -e /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer ]; then "
							+ "mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer.d; "
							+ "printf '[Timer]\\nOnCalendar=\\nOnCalendar=*:00/" + mins + "\\n'"
							+ " > /etc/systemd/system/pinsleep-clock.timer.d/cadence.conf; "
							+ "systemctl daemon-reload; "
							+ "systemctl enable --now pinsleep-clock.timer; "
							+ "systemctl restart pinsleep-clock.timer; fi"]);
					} else {
						pinSleepClockCmd.executeCommand("systemd-run", ["/bin/sh", "-c",
							"systemctl disable --now pinsleep-clock.timer 2>/dev/null"]);
					}
				}

				action: ArkToggleWrapper {
					id: pinSleepClockToggle
					checked: Values.pinSleepClockCadence !== 0
					extendedMouseArea.onPressed: pinSleepClockPanel.activate()
				}

				showAttachment: Values.pinSleepClockCadence !== 0
				attachment: ArkControls.ContextualMenu {
					uniformSize: true
					Repeater {
						model: [ 1, 5, 15 ]
						delegate: ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
							text: modelData === 1 ? qsTr("1 minute")
								: (modelData === 5 ? qsTr("5 minutes")
								: qsTr("15 minutes"))
							selected: Values.pinSleepClockCadence === modelData
							onClicked: pinSleepClockPanel.apply(modelData)
						}
					}
				}
			}

			// Style pickers as ContextualMenu button rows — the SAME square
			// native control the Sleep clock cadence menu above uses (owner
			// ruling 2026-08-19, v0.42: ArkControls.Selector rendered as a
			// round web-style radio). `selected` is driven straight off the
			// stored value, so no autoExclusive grouping to juggle.
			// Second panel in the SAME insert (one AFFECT per file per qmd);
			// which of the mod panels lands first follows exthome load order.
			ArkControls.Panel {
				id: pinSleepStylePanel
				Layout.fillWidth: true
				label: qsTr("Sleep screen style")
				// tier-3 radio (full/outline/cascading) retired in v0.44 —
				// translucent is always dynamic now (see the header)
				description: qsTr("The strip on the sleep screen. Translucent adapts to the picture: a white bar over mostly-white pages, outlined text over anything else.")

				showAttachment: true
				attachment: ColumnLayout {
					Layout.fillWidth: true
					spacing: ArkControls.Values.spacing.large

					ArkControls.ContextualMenu {
						// full column width like the cadence menu above — without
						// it the row shrinks to its contents (owner note 2026-08-20)
						Layout.fillWidth: true
						uniformSize: true
						Repeater {
							model: [ "white", "black", "translucent" ]
							delegate: ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
								required property string modelData
								objectName: "pinSleepStyle_" + modelData
								text: modelData === "white" ? qsTr("White")
									: (modelData === "black" ? qsTr("Black")
									: qsTr("Translucent"))
								selected: Values.pinSleepBarStyle === modelData
								onClicked: Values.pinSleepBarStyle = modelData
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
